items.title: 4.5Microns BOPET thermal transfer film
items.description:
4.5μm High-Performance BOPET TTR Base Film


I. Product Overview

Our Ultra-Thin BOPET Series serves as the premium foundational carrier for high-quality Thermal Transfer Ribbons (TTR) and Hot Stamping Foils. It is engineered to act as a high-heat resistant skeleton for Wax, Resin, and Metallic layers, ensuring high-fidelity transfers in luxury packaging and industrial labeling.

II. Core Technical Advantages

  • Exceptional Thermal Integrity: Engineered to withstand intense print-head heat with a low shrinkage rate ( at °C). This prevents warping and ensures precise registration for multi-color and holographic transfers.
  • Superior Mechanical Tensile Strength: High (Machine Direction) tensile strength allows for gauges as thin as 3.5μm–4.5μm without snapping, even on high-speed slitting and coating equipment.
  • Joint-Free Manufacturing: We provide continuous rolls up to 55,000–65,000 meters without a single joint. This maximizes "Up-Time" for coaters by eliminating machine stops and potential blade damage.
  • Surface Consistency & Adhesion: Controlled surface tension (High Dyne level) provides an ideal substrate for both back-coatings (protecting the print head) and the ink-release layer.

III. Specifications & Logistics

IV. Advanced Application Suitability

  1. Near-Edge Printing: Optimized for rapid-release at high speeds, critical for modern TTO (Thermal Transfer Overprinting) in food packaging.
  2. Resin-Based Ribbons: The high glass transition temperature () of our PET supports the high energy levels needed for pure resin ink melting.
  3. Hot Stamping & Anti-Counterfeiting: A reliable carrier for the complex multi-layer structures of holographic foils used in luxury tobacco, liquor, and pharmaceutical packaging.

V. Professional Industry Jargon (Keywords for Your Catalog)

In your international marketing, you can refer to this product using these industry-standard terms:

  • TTR PET Base Film
  • Electronic Thermal Transfer Basic Film
  • Ultra-Thin Polyester Carrier
  • 4.5um Clear BOPET for Coating
  • Hot Stamping Carrier Film
  • It was the real high industrial technology in BOPET plastic film line with the basic clear film for coating  wax/resin printer ribbons from mainland China elated to the thickness and length of the rolls, and we can manufacture 55,000Meters per roll without any joints, Regarding to the thickness, such as the following: Thickness 4.5Microns BOPET, 4.55Microns BOPET, 4.4Microns BOPET, 4.6Microns BOPET, 4.8Microns BOPET, 5.3Microns BOPET, 4.0 Microns BOPET
  • And usually, in international market dealing practice, buyers sometimes order the sizes as follows: 
  • 4.5Micronsx910MMx18500-65,000M and no joints
  • BOPET TTR films (polyester film for transfer print) were basic film for BOPET Thermal Transfer color Ribbons film, HOT STAMPING FILM, Thermal Transfer Ribbons.
items.descriptionZh:
4.5微米 热转印碳带色带（TTR）用BOPET聚酯薄膜
BOPET 聚酯薄膜光膜 4.5微米
4.0-4.5微米 BOPET TTR 碳带基膜是一种高性能的聚酯薄膜，具有优异的物理和化学性质。它被广泛应用于热转印碳带制造中，作为碳带的基材。
该膜具有以下特点：
1. 高强度：BOPET TTR 碳带基膜具有很高的拉伸强度和模量，可以承受较大的张力。
2. 优异耐磨性：该膜表面光滑平整、硬度高，不易刮花或剥落。
3. 耐化学品侵染：BOPET TTR 碳带基膜对多种化学品都有良好的抗侵染能力，在使用过程中不会因接触到各种溶剂而变形或损坏。
4. 良好尺寸稳定性：由于其低收缩率和低水分吸收率，该膜在温湿环境下也能保持稳定尺寸。
5. 显色效果好：BOPET TTR 碳带基膜透明度高、颜色均匀，并且与碳粉相容性良好，可产生清晰、鲜艳的显色效果。
总之，4.0-4.5微米 BOPET TTR 碳带基膜是一种高品质、高性能的聚酯薄膜，在热转印碳带制造中具有广泛应用前景。
本产品属于超薄膜， 也属于BOPET生产过程中，技术含量仅次与BOPET电容膜的产品类别，属于BOPET TTR即热转移，热转印专用膜。
产品主要规格和品种如下：
1.） 分为表面有单面涂层，和表面无涂层， 目前都是无涂层的光膜为主。
2.） 厚度：3.8,4.0,4.2,4.4,4.5,4.55,4.6,4.8,5.3,5.7,6.0微米（其中主要的标准的厚度是4.4和4.5微米）
3.） 宽度：620,640,650,730,780,750,900,910,930,990,1010,1040,1090,1110,1250,1370,1400,1460,1570,1650MM...（其中主要的宽度是 910,1010）
4.） 长度是：12000,15000,16300,18500,24000,36000,44000,55000,65000M。（其中主要的长度是 16300 和18500米）
5.）纸管：6英寸（152毫米）
6.） 包装：托盘+栈板包装， 横式悬空 包装和纸箱托盘包装。（特殊情况有可以单卷简包）
7.） 装柜数据：12吨/1*20‘GP ，23.5吨/1*40‘
因这个品种在生产过程中，有浪费，所以市场价格较高，次品率存在（薄膜褶皱，表面净化不干净，有黑点，带接头，或者是薄膜厚薄不均匀）。
4.5微米 (4.5MIC) BOPET 薄膜，BOPET 薄膜 4.2微米，4.5MIC BOPET TTR碳带膜，BOPET TTR 热转印聚酯薄膜 4.4/4.5微米，BOPET TTR 聚酯薄膜 4.4/4.5微米
1. 核心产品关键词 (Product Identification) 
BOPET TTR Base Film (最精准：热转印碳带基膜)
Ultra-thin Polyester Film (超薄聚酯薄膜)
4.5 Micron PET Film (4.5微米聚酯膜)
Thermal Transfer Ribbon Carrier (热转印碳带载体)
High-tensile BOPET Film (高拉伸聚酯薄膜)
2. 技术规格关键词 (Technical Specifications)
用于技术协议（TDS）和产品说明书，是工程师最关心的参数：
MD Tensile Strength (纵向张力强度)：4.5MIC BOPET 膜极易断裂，这是核心指标。
Thermal Shrinkage (热收缩率)：通常指 150 度下的收缩，决定打印是否起皱。
Thickness Tolerance (厚度公差)：要求极严，通常在 正负3%以内。
Surface Tension / Dyne Level (表面张力/达因值)：决定涂布油墨的附着力（通常需 42dyne）。
Static Coefficient of Friction (COF) (静摩擦系数)：影响分切时的顺滑度。
Roughness (Ra) (表面粗糙度)：影响背涂层的涂布质量。
3. 目标客户/应用关键词 (Application & Customers)用于锁定下游行业的具体用途：
TTR Coating (碳带涂布)
Ribbon Slitting (碳带分切)
Wax Ribbon / Resin Ribbon / Wax-Resin Ribbon (蜡基/树脂基/混合基碳带)
Barcode Consumables (条码耗材)Thermal Transfer Overprinting (TTO)
 (热转印在线喷码 - 常用于食品包装)Wash Care Ribbon (洗水唛碳带 - 纺织业常用)
4. 行业术语与认证 (Industry Jargon词汇：Jumbo Rolls (母卷/大卷)：通常指 20,000m以上长度的卷材。
Pinholes (针孔)：超薄膜最忌讳的瑕疵。
Anti-static Treatment (抗静电处理)：高端 TTR 膜必备。
RoHS & REACH Compliance (环保合规)：进入欧美及印度大厂的入场券。
Non-stick / Anti-blocking (防粘连)：防止超薄膜卷取后无法剥离。

Wax Ribbon / Resin Ribbon / Wax-Resin Ribbon (蜡基/树脂基/混合基碳带)

4.5Microns B-Grade BOPET Film: Cost-Effective TTR & Lamination Base


While maintaining the core physical properties of polyester, our B-Grade series is optimized for high-volume production in the Barcode and Fax ribbon industries. This grade offers a balance between industrial-grade performance and economic efficiency.

B-Grade film typically features the same thermal resistance as A-grade but may have minor variations that do not impact the final transfer quality in standard applications:

  • Barcode Ribbons (Wax & Wax/Resin): The 4.5um B-grade is the industry standard for shipping labels and retail tags where high-speed throughput and cost-per-print are key.
  • Fax Thermal Ribbons: Excellent heat dissipation ensures the film does not stick to the thermal print head during long transmission cycles.
  • Lamination Base: Used as a thin carrier layer in multi-layer flexible packaging or protective laminates for paper-based tags.
  • Textile Transfer: Suitable for heat-press applications where graphics are transferred from the BOPET carrier onto fabrics.
    • Processing Benefits for Converters

      Note on Storage: To maintain B-grade integrity, rolls should be kept in their original polyethylene wrapping until use to prevent edge damage or dust accumulation, which can cause "pinholes" in the final ribbon coating.

items.description:
Premium BOPET Base Film for Thermal Transfer Ribbons


Our high-performance BOPET (Biaxially Oriented Polyethylene Terephthalate) film serves as the essential substrate for thermal transfer printing. Engineered for precision, this film provides the optimal foundation for ink coating in TTR production, ensuring high-speed printing compatibility, sharp edge definition, and long-term print durability.

Key Performance Advantages

  • Dimensional Stability: Superior resistance to thermal shrinkage ensures consistent ribbon performance even under the high temperatures required for rapid print head cycling.
  • Surface Consistency: The uniform, transparent surface allows for even ink distribution, reducing pinholes and ensuring high-density print quality.
  • Heat Resistance: Designed to withstand the intense thermal output of industrial printers without melting or warping, maintaining structural integrity throughout the printing process.
  • Precision Processing: The film is treated for optimal anchorage, ensuring that wax, resin, and wax-resin ink formulations adhere reliably to the substrate.

Technical Specifications

The following table outlines our standard production ranges for TTR base film. Custom specifications may be available upon request.

Applications

This base film is specifically optimized for high-demand industrial environments:

  • Barcode & Labeling: Ideal for high-speed scanners requiring high-contrast print.
  • Flexible Packaging: Used in food and pharmaceutical date-coding applications.
  • Hot Stamping: Suitable for high-quality decorative and security imprinting.

Packaging & Logistics

To ensure the film arrives in pristine, defect-free condition, we adhere to the following industrial packaging standards:

  1. Core Protection: The film is wound tightly onto high-durability paper cores (76.2mm–152.4mm) to prevent telescoping or edge damage.
  2. Moisture Barrier: Each roll is wrapped in a protective polyethylene film to maintain surface tension and prevent environmental contamination.
  3. Physical Protection: Individual coils are secured with dampeners (to mitigate shock during transport) and placed in reinforced cartons.
  4. Bulk Shipping: Medium-to-large orders are palletized using custom wooden mounts to ensure safe handling and stackability during transit.

items.descriptionZh:
打印碳带色带用BOPET基膜 4.5微米

BOPET 热转印基膜

PET转移膜又称热转印膜，这种转移膜的特点是拉伸强度高，热稳定性好、热收缩率低，表面平整光洁、剥离性好。可多次反复使用。

用途：主要用做真空镀铝的载体。就是将PET膜置于真空镀铝机镀铝后，涂胶与纸复合，然后将PET膜剥离，铝分子层通过 胶粘作用便转移到纸板表面上形成所谓的镀铝卡纸。

厚度：3.5-12微米
宽度：400-1800MM
长度：18500-65000M
内纸芯：3” ，6“
产品特征:良好的厚薄均匀性和印刷适用性

该膜具有以下特点：

items.description:
4.0-4.5Microns BOPET TTR (Thermal Transfer Ribbons) basic film series for carbon

What is BOPET TTR Film?
BOPET stands for Biaxially Oriented Polyethylene Terephthalate — a type of polyester (PET) film that has been stretched in two directions (machine direction and transverse direction) to enhance its mechanical and thermal properties. When used as the base film for Thermal Transfer Ribbons (TTR), it serves as the substrate onto which ink/wax/resin coatings are applied for thermal printing.
Polyester film is the base material of choice for Thermal Transfer Ribbons (TTR). The thermal transfer printing applications are segmented into "standard TTR," Dye Diffusion Thermal Transfer (D2T2), and thermal stencil. For standard TTR, the main thickness is 4.5 microns.
Key Specifications
Available thickness options for BOPET thermal transfer film include 4.4, 4.5, 4.55, 4.6, 4.8, 5.0, 5.7, and 6.0 µm.

Common widths include 500, 600, 910, 980, 1010, 1200, and 1500 mm, and roll lengths range from 15,000 to 37,000 meters. Ec21
Property Detail Material BOPET (Biaxially Oriented PET)

Typical Specifications
Property Typical   Value
Thickness 4.5 μm (±0.1 μm)
Width300–2080 mm (jumbo rolls)
LengthUp to 36,000+ meters per roll
SurfacePlain (often no corona) or treated for adhesion
Core Diameter152.4 mm (6 inches)
Outer Roll Diameter350–600 mm
Heat Shrinkage≤1.5% (150°C, 30 min)

Appearance: Clear / Transparent

Surface: Unprinted & uncoated (base film) HS Code3920620000

4.5Microns Biaxially Oriented Polyethylene Terephthalate (BOPET)
Flexible Packaging: Metallized or plain versions for food packaging, labels, and lamination (provides barrier and printability).
Printing & Laminating: High-quality printing base for graphics and composites.

Key Features & Performance
The combination of mechanical strength and thermal resistance makes polyester film unique for the TTR market. Key properties include dimensional stability, ease of processing/coating, heat resistance, and tear resistance. M-petfilm
BOPET thermal transfer ribbons have excellent stability features in shrinkage and thickness consistency, good heat resistance, and are easy to process in thermal transfer applications. Boppfilmsales
Additionally, compared to transitional capacitor-grade films previously used in TTR applications, purpose-built BOPET for TTR shows greatly improved heat stability, stripping resistance, cleanliness, and surface adaptability to coated solvents, meeting the various performance requirements needed for high-speed TTR coating.
Applications
TTR films are used in a variety of applications including bar code printers, fax printers, portable printers, ticketing machines, monochrome ribbons, and color ribbons. M-petfilm
They are also used as the base for hot stamping films and silver metallized films in specialty printing.
Why 4.5 Microns?
The 4.5-micron gauge represents the industry sweet spot for standard TTR:
Thin enough to transfer heat quickly and efficiently from the print head to the ink layer
Strong enough to resist tearing during high-speed processing and printing
Dimensionally stable to prevent warping, shrinking, or stretching during coating and ribbon slitting
Certain applications use 5.7-micron film, and some specialty products are based on film thicknesses below 4.5 microns — but 4.5 µm is the dominant commercial standard.
Typical Roll Dimensions (Commercial Supply)
Roll lengths available include 15,000; 16,300; 17,000; 18,500; 20,000; 24,000; 36,000; 40,000; 44,000; and up to 55,000 meters. Common widths include 1,200; 1,290; 1,350; 1,400; 1,500; and 1,560 mm. Longer rolls reduce the number of joints in downstream processing, which is critical for high-speed ribbon coating lines.
Summary
BOPET TTR Film at 4.5 microns is a highly engineered, ultra-thin polyester film designed specifically as the backbone of thermal transfer printing ribbons. It balances mechanical durability, thermal conductivity, dimensional stability, and surface compatibility — making it the global standard base film for barcode, label, fax, and specialty thermal printing industries.

4.0-4.5微米 BOPET TTR 碳带基膜
热转印聚酯薄膜是一种用于热转印的材料，由聚酯树脂制成。它具有高强度、耐磨损、抗化学品和紫外线等优点，因此广泛应用于各种标签、商标、装饰图案等领域。

在热转印过程中，将设计好的图案通过特殊设备打印到聚酯薄膜上，并利用高温和压力将图案转移到需要贴附的物体表面。这样可以实现快速而精确地贴附复杂的图案或文字。

热转印聚酯薄膜可应用于各种材料表面，如塑料、金属、玻璃等。其使用范围包括电子产品、家具装潢、汽车零部件等行业。

Flexible Packaging: Metallized or plain versions for food packaging, labels, and lamination (provides barrier and printability).
Printing & Laminating: High-quality printing base for graphics and composites.

Key Features & Performance
The combination of mechanical strength and thermal resistance makes polyester film unique for the TTR market. Key properties include dimensional stability, ease of processing/coating, heat resistance, and tear resistance. M-petfilm
BOPET thermal transfer ribbons have excellent stability features in shrinkage and thickness consistency, good heat resistance, and are easy to process in thermal transfer applications. Boppfilmsales
Additionally, compared to transitional capacitor-grade films previously used in TTR applications, purpose-built BOPET for TTR shows greatly improved heat stability, stripping resistance, cleanliness, and surface adaptability to coated solvents, meeting the various performance requirements needed for high-speed TTR coating.
Applications
TTR films are used in a variety of applications including bar code printers, fax printers, portable printers, ticketing machines, monochrome ribbons, and color ribbons. M-petfilm
They are also used as the base for hot stamping films and silver metallized films in specialty printing.
Why 4.5 Microns?
The 4.5-micron gauge represents the industry sweet spot for standard TTR:
Thin enough to transfer heat quickly and efficiently from the print head to the ink layer
Strong enough to resist tearing during high-speed processing and printing
Dimensionally stable to prevent warping, shrinking, or stretching during coating and ribbon slitting
Certain applications use 5.7-micron film, and some specialty products are based on film thicknesses below 4.5 microns — but 4.5 µm is the dominant commercial standard.
Typical Roll Dimensions (Commercial Supply)
Roll lengths available include 15,000; 16,300; 17,000; 18,500; 20,000; 24,000; 36,000; 40,000; 44,000; and up to 55,000 meters. Common widths include 1,200; 1,290; 1,350; 1,400; 1,500; and 1,560 mm. Longer rolls reduce the number of joints in downstream processing, which is critical for high-speed ribbon coating lines.
Summary
BOPET TTR Film at 4.5 microns is a highly engineered, ultra-thin polyester film designed specifically as the backbone of thermal transfer printing ribbons. It balances mechanical durability, thermal conductivity, dimensional stability, and surface compatibility — making it the global standard base film for barcode, label, fax, and specialty thermal printing industries.

4.5µm BOPET substandard (off-grade) products in the printing and lamination

B grade stock BOPET TTR film 3.8-4.55MIC uncoating , clear transparent


In the world of Biaxially-Oriented Polyethylene Terephthalate (BOPET) production, 4.5-micrometer (4.5MIC) film is an ultra-thin specialty product primarily designed for high-end applications like Thermal Transfer Ribbons (TTR) 
"Substandard" (Off-grade/B-grade) refers to batches that fail the rigorous "Electrical" or "TTR" grade standards due to minor thickness fluctuations, surface crystals (pinholes), or tension inconsistencies. However, these materials are highly sought after in the Printing Composite (Lamination) industry due to their extreme cost-efficiency.
1. Why Use Substandard 4.5μm Film for Composites? In standard flexible packaging, 12micPET is the norm. 
Shifting to 4.5MICsubstandard products offers three major strategic advantages:
Extreme High Yield: 4.5MIC film provides approximately 2.6 times more surface area per kilogram compared to 12mic film (158M2 vs 60 m^
2.Cost Reduction: Substandard products are often sold at a 20%–40% discount compared to prime TTR-grade film. Combined with the high yield, this drastically slashes raw material costs.
Enhanced Barrier Properties: Even as a "substandard" product, PET offers superior oxygen and aroma barriers compared to BOPP or PE of the same thickness.
2. Typical Application ScenariosSubstandard 4.5mic film is rarely used alone; it is almost always laminated to a thicker substrate which provides the necessary mechanical support.A. Paper-to-Film Lamination (Luxury Packaging)
Application: Gift boxes, high-end shopping bags, and book covers.Process: The film is laminated to cardboard. The paper provides the "backbone," while the 4.5mic PET adds a high-gloss, water-resistant finish.
Benefit: Minor thickness variations in the film are invisible once bonded to the opaque paper.
B. Vacuum Metallized Composites (VMPET)Application: Snack food pouches (inner layer) or decorative "gold/silver" cardstock.Process: 
The film is metallized with aluminum. Small surface defects (crystals) are often covered by the metal layer.
Benefit: Provides an excellent moisture barrier for a fraction of the cost of standard VMPET.
C. Triple-Layer Flexible Packaging Structure: BOPP  /  4.5 mic PET Substandard} / CPP.
Usage: Used as a middle "stiffening" and barrier layer. It adds "crinkle" and heat resistance to the pouch without adding significant bulk.
3. Technical Challenges & WorkaroundsUsing substandard ultra-thin film requires specific adjustments on the factory floor to avoid high scrap rates:
4. When dealing with 4.5µm BOPET substandard (off-grade) products in the printing and lamination sector, your communication needs to pivot from "precision/perfection" to "yield/value/utility." 
Here are the essential keywords categorized for marketing, technical negotiation, and procurement.
1. Value Proposition Keywords (The "Sales" Pitch)Since these are substandard products, the focus is on the economic benefit for the lamination plant.
Yield Advantage: The most important term. It refers to the massive amount of square meters obtained per kilogram (158 m^2).
Cost-Benefit Ratio: Highlighting that the lower price point justifies the minor technical adjustments needed.Substrate Replacement: Using 4.5µm to replace thicker $10\mu\text{m}$ or $12\mu\text{m}$ films in non-critical applications.Plastic Reduction / Lightweighting: Positioning the film as a "Green" solution by using less polymer for the same coverage area.
Overrun / Stock Lot: Professional terms for "substandard" that imply the product is still high quality but available at a clearance price.
2. Technical Deficiency Keywords (The "Honest" Jargon)To manage customer expectations and avoid claims, use these terms to describe why it is substandard.
Gauge Variation / Thickness Fluctuation: The film is not perfectly 4.5mic across the entire web.
Surface Defects / Gel / Fish-eyes: Small lumps or impurities in the film that might affect high-definition printing but are fine for lamination.
Tension Inconsistency: The roll might be "loose" on one side and "tight" on the other (baggy edges).
Profile Deviation: Refers to the "high and low" spots on the jumbo roll.
Transmittance Issues: If the film is slightly hazy or not perfectly clear.
3. Lamination & Processing Keywords
These terms describe how the film will be used in the factory.
Dry Lamination: The most common process for this film (using solvent-based or solvent-less adhesives)
.Paper-to-Film Bonding: Specifically for greeting cards, book covers, and luxury boxes.
Tie-Layer: Using the PET as a middle layer between two other materials (e.g., BOPP/PET/PE).
Corona Treatment / Dyne Level: Ensuring the "off-grade" film still has enough surface energy for the glue to stick.
Low-Tension Unwinding: A necessary machine setting to handle ultra-thin substandard film without snapping it.
4. Application-Specific KeywordsWhere exactly is this "substandard" film going Gold/Silver 
Cardstock: Laminated PET used as a base for metallic inks in the tobacco or liquor packaging industry.
Thermal Lamination: If the PET has been pre-coated with EVA glue (though rare for 4.5µm, it’s a growing niche).
Flexible Packaging Inner Layer: Used for its barrier properties in snack food or condiment pouches.
Protective Over-lamination: Simply providing a "scratch-proof" layer for printed paper.
5. Logistics & Specification Keywords Crucial for the "Proforma Invoice" or "Packing List."
Jumbo Rolls: Usually 24,000m to 40,000m in length.
Net Weight vs. Gross Weight: Standard trading terms.
Core Diameter: Usually 3" or 6".
COF (Coefficient of Friction): Very important; if the COF is too high, the "substandard" film will stick to itself and be unusable.
OD (Outer Diameter): Ensuring the roll fits on the customer's lamination machine.

4.5微米 热转印碳带色带（TTR）用BOPET聚酯薄膜

BOPET 薄膜 4.2微米

产品主要规格和品种如下：

1.） 分为表面有单面涂层，和表面无涂层， 目前都是无涂层的光膜为主。

2.） 厚度：3.8,4.0,4.2,4.4,4.5,4.55,4.6,4.8,5.3,5.7,6.0微米（其中主要的标准的厚度是4.4和4.5微米）

3.） 宽度：620,640,650,730,780,750,900,910,930,990,1010,1040,1090,1110,1250,1370,1400,1460,1570,1650MM...（其中主要的宽度是 910,1010）

4.） 长度是：12000,15000,16300,18500,24000,36000,44000,55000,65000M。（其中主要的长度是 16300 和18500米）

5.）纸管：6英寸（152毫米）

6.） 包装：托盘+栈板包装， 横式悬空 包装和纸箱托盘包装。（特殊情况有可以单卷简包）

7.） 装柜数据：12吨/1*20‘GP ，23.5吨/1*40‘

因这个品种在生产过程中，有浪费，所以市场价格较高，次品率存在（薄膜褶皱，表面净化不干净，有黑点，带接头，或者是薄膜厚薄不均匀）

8.）部分次品B级品用于印刷包装行业，做一色印刷

items.description:
4.5Microns BOPET thermal transfer film
4.5-Micron (4.5μm) BOPET (Biaxially-Oriented Polyethylene Terephthalate) film is the "gold standard" base material for the global Thermal Transfer Ribbon (TTR) industry. At this thickness, the film achieves a critical balance between thermal conductivity, mechanical strength, and cost-efficiency.
Below is a comprehensive technical and industrial breakdown of this specialized material.
1. Technical Specifications & Material Structure
BOPET is produced by stretching polyethylene terephthalate in two perpendicular directions (Machine Direction - MD, and Transverse Direction - TD). For TTR applications, the film is not just "thin plastic"; it is a high-performance carrier.
Core Physical Properties
2. The Multi-Layer Architecture of TTR
In a finished thermal transfer ribbon, the 4.5-micron BOPET acts as the central skeleton. A high-quality ribbon consists of four distinct layers:
Back-coat Layer (<0.1μm): Protects the print head from friction and prevents static build-up.
BOPET Base Film (4.5μm): The carrier that withstands the heat and tension.
Release/Primer Layer: Ensures the ink peels off cleanly when heated.
Ink Layer (2−4μm): Wax, Wax-Resin, or Resin that transfers to the label.
3. Why 4.5 Microns? (The Industry Choice)
While TTR can range from 3.5μm to 6.0μm, the 4.5-micron specification dominates for several reasons:
Thermal Sensitivity: It is thin enough to allow near-instantaneous heat transfer from the print head to the ink, enabling high-speed printing (up to 12 inches per second).
Roll Capacity: Standard industrial printers have fixed outer diameter limits for ribbon rolls. A 4.5-micron base allows for longer rolls (e.g., 450m or 600m), reducing downtime for roll changes.
Cost vs. Performance: It is the "sweet spot" where the film is thin enough to save on material costs but thick enough to maintain the structural integrity needed for high-speed coating machines.
4. Key Application Segments
Wax Ribbons: The most common use. 4.5-micron film is the standard carrier for shipping labels and retail tags.
Wax-Resin Ribbons: Used for higher-durability labels (e.g., pharmaceutical or warehouse tracking).
Resin Ribbons: Usually requires the highest grade of 4.5-micron film with superior heat resistance for chemical and automotive labeling.
5. Global Market Dynamics
Challenges in Production 4.5-micron TTR base film.
Manufacturing 4.5-micron film is significantly harder than standard packaging film (12μm). The main hurdles are:
Thickness Uniformity: Even a 0.3μm deviation can cause "dark spots" or "light spots" in the final print.
Dust Control: In a film this thin, a single microscopic dust particle can cause a "pinhole" or a tear during the coating process.
6. Future Trends
Down-gauging: The industry is slowly testing 4.0μm and 3.5μm films to fit more meters on a roll, though this requires significantly more expensive resin and tighter machine tolerances.
Sustainability: Development of "Post-Consumer Recycled" (PCR) BOPET for ribbons to meet ESG goals of major retailers.
7. the key words Of 4.5Microns BOPET film --
4.5-Micron (4.5MIC) BOPET film TTR Base Film: (Thermal Transfer Ribbon Base Film) — The most specific industry term.
Ultra-thin BOPET: Differentiates the product from standard 12mic packaging film
High-Heat PET Film: Highlights the film's ability to withstand print head temperatures.
Capacitor Grade Film: (Sometimes used interchangeably due to similar thickness, 
though TTR grade has different surface treatments).4.5µm Polyester Carrier: Emphasizes its role as a vehicle for ink.

items.description:
4.5Mic BOPET film clear transparent , unprinting &  uncoating ( for printing and laminating) 


The 4.5-Micron (4.5um) clear, transparent BOPET film in its "unprinted and uncoated" state isthe rawest form of high-performance polyester substrate. In the industry, this is often referredto as "Plain Base Film" or "Primary Film." When used specifically for printing andlaminating, this ultra-thin gauge serves as a high-clarity carrier that allows the graphics of thesubstrate beneath it to show through with maximum brilliance.
1. Technical Profile: The "Plain" Base FilmUnlike TTR-grade film (which may have back-coatings) or Metallized film (which has analuminum layer), the Clear/Transparent version focuses on optical purity and surface energy.
2. Why Use "Clear & Uncoated" 4.5um for Lamination?Using a plain 4.5jum film instead of a 12um film or a pre-coated film offers specific industrialadvantages:
A. The "Invisible" Protective ShieldBecause the film is so thin (4.5pm), it is nearly invisible once laminated to paper or cardstock.It provides a high-gloss finish and scratch resistance without the bulk or "plastic feel" of
thicker films.
B. Optimal Thermal Conductivity
In "Thermal Lamination" (where the film is bonded using heat and a thin glue layer), the 4.5umthickness allows heat to pass through almost instantly. This enables faster line speeds onlamination machines compared to thicker substrates.
C. Superior Yield (Area Coverage)
This is the strongest commercial argument.
· 12m PET:Yields ≈ 60 m2/kg.
· 4.5um PET:Yields ≈ 158 m2/kg.
Result: You cover 2.6 times more area with the same weight of plastic, significantlylowering the "cost per square meter."
3. Application Workflow: Printing & Lamination
When a factory buys "Clear Uncoated" 4.5jum film, the process typically follows these steps:1. Reverse Printing (Optional): The film is printed on the "inside" (the side that will beglued). This protects the ink from scratches because it is sandwiched between the filmand the paper.
2. Adhesive Coating: A lamination adhesive (solvent-based or solvent-less) is applied to thetreated side of the 4.5um PET.
3. Nip Rolling (The Lamination): The PET film and the target substrate (e.g., printedcardboard) are pressed together between heated rollers.
4. Curing: The composite is left to dry or cure, creating a permanent bond.
4. Key Performance Keywords for This GradeIf you are sourcing or selling this specific "Clear & Uncoated" grade, use these terms to definethe quality:
 Optical Grade: Implies the film is free of "gel" or "fish-eyes" that would ruin the look of aprinted box.
Slip Level: "Medium Slip" is usually preferred so the film can be rewound easily withoutsticking to itself (blocking).
Antistatic Properties: Plain film can be very static-prone; specify "Anti-static treated" ifusing high-speed automatic feeders.
Shrinkage Control: Crucial for lamination; if the film shrinks too much in the dryingtunnel, the final laminated product will "curl."
5. Typical End-Use Products
· Luxury Food Packaging: Glossy boxes for chocolates or tea.
Book Covers & Magazines: High-end dust jackets.
Cosmetic Cartons: Providing a premium, wipe-clean surface.
Security/ldentity Threads: Slit into very narrow strips and embedded into paper.
Would you like me to prepare a "Yield Comparison Chart" for 4.5jm vs. 6jm vs. 12um?This is often the most effective tool for convincing a lamination plant to switch to the thinner
4.5um grade.

进口BOPP电容膜基膜-光膜
进口BOPP 电容膜光膜 2.0-3.0微米
BOPP电容膜 聚丙烯薄膜电容膜由于具有无极性、绝缘阻抗高、频率响应宽广、介质损失小等优点，因此，大量应用于交流电机、家用电器、电力电容器等领域，是BOPP薄膜类的顶端产品。据不完全统计，国内有20余家电容膜生产商，绝大部分是采用专用设备生产，有些则是改造生产BOPP包装印刷膜的设备生产的。
生产线大多从德国布鲁克纳公司引进，薄膜宽度从3.2m扩展到5.2m，加工速度从150m/min提高到300 m/min，厚度已降至3 μm，品种从原有的金属化膜和粗化膜，升级到耐高温电容膜。与普通薄膜相比，其弹性模量增加40%以上，纵向热收缩率降低0.8%，介电强度增大50V，用其制备的电容器的耐压性和耐候性大幅提高。
我司长期提供进口 日本东丽美国杜邦等 BOPP电容膜 超薄光膜  2.4-3.0微米的（ 大部分是2.4， 2.6， 2.9微米的）BOPP聚丙烯电容膜光膜。
规格是 580,600,620,820,920,1020,1040MM  重量：50-200公斤一卷，单卷简包，常年仓库储存数量20-50吨，交货期：即时发货。有需要的客户请联系，谢谢！

BOPP电容膜
电容膜与金属箔等电极从两端重叠后，卷绕成圆筒状的构造就称之为电容器。
目前多直接在塑料薄膜上真空蒸镀上一层很薄的金属做为电极，以便省去电极箔的厚度，缩小电容器单位容量的体积，容量大的电容器。此类薄膜以金属BOPP膜为代表，已经成为电容膜的主流产品。
薄膜电容器
目前电容薄膜的生产工艺主要采用平膜法：将高分子聚丙烯的熔体通过狭长机头制成片材或厚膜，然后在专用的拉伸机内，在一定的温度和设定的速度下，同时或分步在垂直的两个方向（纵向、横向）上进行的拉伸，使高聚物的分子链可结晶面在平行于薄膜平面的方向上进行取向而有序排列；然后在拉紧状态下进行热定型使取向的大分子结构固定下来电容薄膜，并经过适当的冷却或热处理或特殊的加工（如电晕、涂覆等）制成。
该方法能高速生产宽幅薄膜，产品厚度均匀，性能稳定。
BOPP电容薄膜的下游较为单一，基本上均用于生产薄膜电容器。
薄膜电容器的主要原材料为电容薄膜、金属材料、树脂材料、引线及引片材料、壳体材料，其中电容薄膜约占全部原材料总成本的 70%左右。

items.title: 4.5 Microns BOPET Film silver metallized
items.description:
4.5 Micron Silver Metallized BOPET


4.5 Micron Silver Metallized BOPET Film, this material represents the high-performance intersection of ultra-thin gauge technology and advanced vacuum deposition. At 4.5 microns, it offers a high yield per kilogram, making it exceptionally cost-effective for large-scale industrial applications.

1. Enhanced Barrier Performance

While the base BOPET provides structural integrity, the vacuum-deposited aluminum layer (typically Ångströms thick) creates a "tortuous path" for molecules.

  • Light Barrier: 100% opacity in the UV and visible spectrum, preventing degradation of light-sensitive contents.
  • Moisture & Oxygen: Significantly lowers the WVTR (Water Vapor Transmission Rate) and OTR (Oxygen Transmission Rate) compared to plain film.

2. Advanced Surface Characteristics

  • Reflectivity: High specular reflection (mirror-finish) for premium aesthetics and thermal insulation (radiant heat reflection).
  • Surface Tension: Treated to maintain high dyne levels (typically dynes/cm), ensuring that inks and lamination adhesives bond permanently to the metal side.
  • Metal Adhesion: Engineered to prevent "metal pick-off" during high-speed rewinding or subsequent lamination.

Key Application Breakdown

Processing & Handling Recommendations

  • Tension Control: Due to the 4.5um thickness, precise tension control is mandatory. We recommend ultrasonic sensors and low-inertia rollers to prevent stretching or "web-breaks."
  • Static Management: Metallized films can generate significant static; the use of active ionizer bars during slitting is highly recommended.
  • Storage: Should be stored in a climate-controlled environment (°C, humidity) to prevent "oxidation" of the aluminum layer, which can dull the silver luster over time.

Quality Standards

Our 4.5 micron film is tested for:

  1. Optical Density (OD): Measured to ensure consistent aluminum thickness across the web.
  2. Pinholes: Rigorous inspection to ensure barrier integrity.
  3. Coefficient of Friction (COF): Optimized for "Excellent Machinability" on high-speed VFFS (Vertical Form Fill Seal) machines.
  4. 4.5 Microns BOPET Film silver metallized, Bopet polyester metallized film has a super reflective, mirror- like surface. It is a oriented polyester film with a very
  5. thin coating of aluminum that is vacuum deposited on to the surface of the film. This film is used in a variety of
  6. industrial and applications, including printing, packaging, crafts and many other applications.
  7. Main features of bopet polyester metallized film
  8. a. Good Metal Bond Strength
  9. b. Good Barrier properties of oxygen, light, water vapor
  10. c. Good Lamination Bond Strength
  11. d. Excellent Machinability

2. Advanced Surface Characteristics

  • Reflectivity: High specular reflection (mirror-finish) for premium aesthetics and thermal insulation (radiant heat reflection).
  • Surface Tension: Treated to maintain high dyne levels (typically dynes/cm), ensuring that inks and lamination adhesives bond permanently to the metal side.
  • Metal Adhesion: Engineered to prevent "metal pick-off" during high-speed rewinding or subsequent lamination.

Key Application Breakdown

Processing & Handling Recommendations

  • Tension Control: Due to the 4.5um thickness, precise tension control is mandatory. We recommend ultrasonic sensors and low-inertia rollers to prevent stretching or "web-breaks."
  • Static Management: Metallized films can generate significant static; the use of active ionizer bars during slitting is highly recommended.
  • Storage: Should be stored in a climate-controlled environment (°C, humidity) to prevent "oxidation" of the aluminum layer, which can dull the silver luster over time.

  1. Optical Density (OD): Measured to ensure consistent aluminum thickness across the web.
  2. Pinholes: Rigorous inspection to ensure barrier integrity.
  3. Coefficient of Friction (COF): Optimized for "Excellent Machinability" on high-speed VFFS (Vertical Form Fill Seal) machines.

items.title: BOPET Thermal Transfer Ribbon (TTR) Film 4.5Microns
items.description:
BOPET Thermal Transfer Ribbon (TTR) Film 4.5Microns


4.5 microns BOPET Thermal Transfer Ribbon (TTR) Film is an ultra-thin, high-performance material specifically designed for thermal transfer printing applications. It is widely used in industries requiring high-resolution, durable, and efficient printing, such as barcode labeling, product identification, and industrial marking. Below is a detailed introduction to this specialized film:
1. Material Overview
Thickness: 4.5 microns (µm), making it an ultra-thin film.
Base Material: Biaxially Oriented Polyethylene Terephthalate (BOPET), a type of polyester film known for its strength, thermal stability, and dimensional stability.
Structure: Typically consists of three layers:
Base Film: The BOPET layer provides mechanical support and stability.
Ink Layer: A thermally sensitive coating containing wax, resin, or a hybrid formulation, which transfers onto the substrate during printing.
Back Coating: A protective layer that reduces friction, prevents static buildup, and protects the print head from wear and tear.
2. Key Features
High Resolution: The 4.5-micron thickness allows for precise and sharp printing, ideal for detailed barcodes, text, and graphics.
Durability: Printed images are resistant to abrasion, chemicals, and environmental factors, ensuring long-lasting legibility.
Efficiency: The ultra-thin design reduces material usage, lowering costs while maintaining high print quality.
Compatibility: Suitable for a wide range of substrates, including paper, synthetic labels, and textiles.
Thermal Stability: Withstands high temperatures during the thermal transfer process without deformation.
3. Applications
4.5 microns BOPET TTR film is widely used in industries that require high-quality, durable printing:
Barcode Printing: For retail, logistics, and inventory management systems.
Product Labeling: For consumer goods, pharmaceuticals, and industrial products.
Asset Tagging: For tracking and identification in manufacturing and healthcare.
Specialized Printing: For applications requiring high durability and precision, such as electronics and automotive parts labeling.
4. Manufacturing Process
Base Film Production: High-quality BOPET film is produced through biaxial orientation, enhancing its strength and thermal stability.
Coating Application: The ink layer is uniformly applied to the base film using advanced coating technologies.
Back Coating: A protective layer is added to the opposite side of the base film to ensure smooth operation and print head protection.
Slitting and Packaging: The film is precision-slitted to the required width and packaged for distribution.
5. Advantages and Challenges
Advantages:
Ultra-thin and lightweight, reducing material costs.
High print quality with excellent resolution.
Durable and resistant to environmental factors.
Compatible with a wide range of thermal transfer printers.
Challenges:
Requires advanced manufacturing techniques to ensure uniformity and quality.
Sensitive to handling and storage conditions due to its thinness.
6. Market Outlook

The demand for 4.5 microns BOPET TTR film is growing due to the increasing adoption of barcode technology, automation in logistics, and the need for high-quality labeling in various industries. Its superior performance and cost-effectiveness make it a preferred choice for thermal transfer printing applications.

items.descriptionZh:
聚脂薄膜 12,23,36 微米/BOPET film (Polyester film)

BOPET普通印刷膜

产品特点:常规厚度为12～125μm。产品对油墨、涂覆有好的附着性、可用于多色套印、平整度好。 主要应用于冷冻食品热封袋及食品、工业品和化妆品等的包装。

BOPET普通镀铝膜
产品特点：常规厚度为12～36μm。镀铝PET膜可分为无表面处理、单面电晕处理、双面电晕处理、高透明型等类型。产品具有加工性好、铝层的附着力好、镀铝后铝层亮度好、机械性能优良等特点。

镀铝PET膜除可用于镀铝外，也适用于印刷复合或卡纸复合用途, 防水材料用途.

作为装饰膜使用，如串花工艺品、圣诞花等；

镀铝基膜除了用在软包装用途上之外，还可用于上。

BOPET薄膜的厚度可以从1-400不等，同时其这使得BOPET薄膜成为目前的薄膜塑料。以薄膜的厚度区分，6微米以下聚酯薄膜主要用于加工电容器膜；20微米以下的聚酯薄膜主要用来做带状基材（如录音带、录像带等）及大部分包装印刷用薄膜，通常25微米以下的薄膜称为薄型膜。25-65微米的聚酯薄膜多用于护卡、防伪、标牌、拆封拉线、胶带等；65微米以上的厚型膜则主要为了满足特种护卡膜、胶片、X光片、电工绝缘等较厚膜的需要。

BOPET （1）BOPET，BOPET熔点为260摄氏度，在-70摄氏度-220摄氏度的范围内仍具有良好的坚牢度和韧性，可以长期在-70-150摄氏度下使用，而BOPP（熔点为170摄氏度）温度超过120摄氏度性能不太稳定，而通常镀铝时温度较高；（2），而BOPP、PE薄膜可印刷性能次于BOPET；（3）（例如氧气的穿透率仅为BOPP的十分之一）；（4）可回收性强；

BOPET薄膜的设备状况。布鲁克纳将它的设备分为两类，，这类设备生产薄膜的厚度通常在125微米以下，薄膜主要用于包装行业，包括普通包装膜、印刷膜、热封膜、烫金膜、收缩膜等；，这类设备生产薄膜的厚度从50-400微米不等，主要是显像用膜、电子电器用膜以及工业用膜，如光学膜、背板膜、绝缘膜、医学用膜等。

items.bodyHtmlZh:
聚脂薄膜 12,23,36 微米/BOPET film (Polyester film)

BOPET普通印刷膜

产品特点:常规厚度为12～125μm。产品对油墨、涂覆有好的附着性、可用于多色套印、平整度好。 主要应用于冷冻食品热封袋及食品、工业品和化妆品等的包装。

BOPET普通镀铝膜
产品特点：常规厚度为12～36μm。镀铝PET膜可分为无表面处理、单面电晕处理、双面电晕处理、高透明型等类型。产品具有加工性好、铝层的附着力好、镀铝后铝层亮度好、机械性能优良等特点。

镀铝PET膜除可用于镀铝外，也适用于印刷复合或卡纸复合用途, 防水材料用途.

作为装饰膜使用，如串花工艺品、圣诞花等；

镀铝基膜除了用在软包装用途上之外，还可用于上。

BOPET薄膜的厚度可以从1-400不等，同时其这使得BOPET薄膜成为目前的薄膜塑料。以薄膜的厚度区分，6微米以下聚酯薄膜主要用于加工电容器膜；20微米以下的聚酯薄膜主要用来做带状基材（如录音带、录像带等）及大部分包装印刷用薄膜，通常25微米以下的薄膜称为薄型膜。25-65微米的聚酯薄膜多用于护卡、防伪、标牌、拆封拉线、胶带等；65微米以上的厚型膜则主要为了满足特种护卡膜、胶片、X光片、电工绝缘等较厚膜的需要。

BOPET （1）BOPET，BOPET熔点为260摄氏度，在-70摄氏度-220摄氏度的范围内仍具有良好的坚牢度和韧性，可以长期在-70-150摄氏度下使用，而BOPP（熔点为170摄氏度）温度超过120摄氏度性能不太稳定，而通常镀铝时温度较高；（2），而BOPP、PE薄膜可印刷性能次于BOPET；（3）（例如氧气的穿透率仅为BOPP的十分之一）；（4）可回收性强；

BOPET薄膜的设备状况。布鲁克纳将它的设备分为两类，，这类设备生产薄膜的厚度通常在125微米以下，薄膜主要用于包装行业，包括普通包装膜、印刷膜、热封膜、烫金膜、收缩膜等；，这类设备生产薄膜的厚度从50-400微米不等，主要是显像用膜、电子电器用膜以及工业用膜，如光学膜、背板膜、绝缘膜、医学用膜等。

items.title: Polyester based film clear transparent for Thermal Lamination Film coated
items.summary: Polyester based film clear transparent for Thermal Lamination Film coated
items.description:
Polyester based film clear transparent for Thermal Lamination Film coated

PROFILE: It is polyester based, both sides corona treated, uniformly extrusion coated with adhesive which enables lamination by heat and pressure with paper products.

FEATURES  :

1)    Fibre-tear bond strength with paper

2) Excellent optical properties.

3) Excellent resistance to elongation & tear.

4) Offer increased productivity with simple operation.

APPLICATIONS : Thermal lamination with all kinds of printed & unprinted paper and paper boards like maps, book covers,  posters, magazines, boxes, brochures etc.

items.offer:
12Microns thermal transfer BOPET film no corona treatment

BOPET PLAIN FILM
BOPET film (biaxially oriented Polyester films) featurines good thermal stability and tenacity; low air and water permeability; applicable to vacuum aluminum plating, compound package, cooking bag manufacture, etc. 
Featuring : 
Having the good adhesion with ink and coating, can be used for multi-color printings with good flatness. Is mainly used in heat-sealing bags of frozen food, industrial products and cosmetics packaging.
Specification:
thickness: 12 microns-25 microns, 75 microns-150 microns ,185 microns-380 microns, 500 microns
width :200-1200MM 
length : 500m ,1000m ,1500m,4000m,6000m,9000m,12000m
Polyester film is wound around paper shaft with an internal diameter of 76.2mm-152.4mm and covered with polyethylene film; each coil is supported by damper and put in carton; medium and large package needs wooden mount.
Customer's own requirement is available for us such as printed OEM logos and private label or particular size and package style.

items.bodyHtml:
BOPET film 6.0 microns

BOPET film (biaxially oriented Polyester films) featurines good thermal stability and tenacity; low air and water permeability; applicable to vacuum aluminum plating, compound package, cooking bag manufacture, etc.

Featuring :

Having the good adhesion with ink and coating, can be used for multi-color printings with good flatness. Is mainly used in heat-sealing bags of frozen food, industrial products and cosmetics packaging.
Specification:
thickness: 12 microns-25 microns, 75 microns-150 microns ,185 microns-380 microns, 500 microns
width :200-1200MM
length : 500m ,1000m ,1500m,4000m,6000m,9000m,12000m
Polyester film is wound around paper shaft with an internal diameter of 76.2mm-152.4mm and covered with polyethylene film; each coil is supported by damper and put in carton; medium and large package needs wooden mount.
Customer's own requirement is available for us such as printed OEM logos and private label or particular size and package style.

industrial and applications, including printing, packaging, crafts and many other applications.

items.description:

features: high tensile strength, good oxygen barrier property, high definition and gloss, and excellent dimensional stability, good flatness, good ink adhesion, excellent dimensional
stability and workability.
usage/application: printing & laminating.
a.) suitable for printing machinery, and higher adaptability of high-speed printing machinery
b.) laminating: able to compound with paper, card, pe, bopa, bopp films and other materials.
c.) stock lot films widely used in paper lamination
d.) surface treatment: corona one side or corona two sides.
e.) specifications and dimensions; 4.5-4.55mic*620-1,485mm*12,000-36,000m*6"core

items.title: Vacuum Aluminum Metallized 4.5 Micron BOPET polyester Film
items.summary: Vacuum Aluminum Metallized 4.5 Micron BOPET polyester Film
items.description:
Vacuum Aluminum Metallized 4.5 Micron BOPET polyester Film
Vacuum aluminum metallized 4.5-micron (4.5um) BOPET (VMPET) is a high-performance, ultra-thin specialty material. 
In this configuration, the 4.5µm polyester base provides the structural carrier, while a nanometer-scale layer of vaporized aluminum provides high-reflectivity and barrier properties.
Here is a detailed breakdown of its properties, applications, and technical significance.
1. Key Technical PropertiesUltra-Thin Gauge: At 4.5 microns, it is one of the thinnest commercially available metallized films. 
This allows for maximum "yield" (more square meters per kilogram of material).
High Barrier Performance: The aluminum layer significantly reduces the Oxygen Transmission Rate (OTR) and Water Vapor Transmission Rate (WVTR) compared to clear film.
Thermal Stability: As a BOPET-based material, it maintains dimensional stability at highertemperatures (melting point ≈ 260° C), which is critical for heat-sealing and high-speedlamination.
Optical Density (OD): Typically ranges from 1.8 to 2.5. This determines the "brightness"and opacity of the silver finish.
High Tensile Strength: Despite its thinness, the biaxial orientation gives it the mechanicalstrength to be processed on industrial coating and slitting machines without stretching orsnapping
2. Primary Applications
A. Thermal Transfer Ribbons (TTR) - Premium Grade
The Role: Metallized 4.5um BOPET is often used as the base for high-end resin or wax-resin ribbons.
The Benefit: The metallization can act as a "heat-shield" or a primer layer that improvesthe release of the ink and protects the print head from overheating.
B. High-Performance Lamination (Flexible Packaging)
The Role: It acts as the middle barrier layer in a multi-layer structure (e.g.,BOPP /VMPET 4.5m / PE).
The Benefit: It provides the barrier of a much thicker film while keeping the totalpackaging weight extremely low. This is ideal for snack food pouches and "lightweighting"initiatives.
C. Insulation & Electronics
The Role: Used in Cryogenic Insulation (multi-layer insulation or MLI) and radiantbarriers.
The Benefit: The silver surface reflects up to 98% of radiant heat. Its ultra-thin natureallows for many layers to be wrapped in a small space (crucial for aerospace and LNG tankinsulation).
Capacitors: Some ultra-thin metallized BOPET is used in the manufacturing of filmcapacitors.
D. Decorative & Yarn Applications
The Role: Slit into tiny strips to create Metallic Yarn (Lurex) for textiles.
The Benefit: Provides high shine and metallic luster while remaining soft enough to bewoven into fabrics.
3. Comparison: Metallized vs. Aluminum Foil
4. Technical Keywords for Sourcing
When communicating with suppliers (like Shuangxing, Toray, or CloudFilm), use thesespecific terms:
VMPET 4.5mic: Short for Vacuum Metallized PET.
Metal Bond Strength: The force required to peel the aluminum from the PET (crucial forlamination).
 Dyne Level: Usually needs to be > 42 dyne for lamination adhesive to stick.
 Yield (m2/kg): For 4.5uum, the yield is approximately 158 m2/kg.
Pro-Tip for Purchasing:
If you are buying 4.5um Metallized Off-grade (Substandard), it is excellent for paper-to-cardboard lamination (like luxury cigarette or liquor boxes). The paper provides the strength,and the "substandard" metallization still provides 100% of the required metallic aesthetic for amuch lower price.

items.title: 6 Microns Metallized BOPET Film
items.description:
6 Microns Metallized BOPET Film

6 microns (often written as 6um) represents one of the thinnest commercially available gauges for Biaxially-oriented Polyethylene Terephthalate (BOPET) film. When this ultra-thin substrate is "metallized"—usually with a microscopic layer of high-purity aluminum—it becomes a high-performance material used primarily in specialized industrial and packaging applications.

Key Technical Specifications

Property

Typical Value / Description

Thickness

6um (0.006mm/24 gauge)

Material

Polyester (PET) resin stretched in two directions

Metallization

Vacuum-deposited Aluminum (VMPET)

Optical Density

Typically 2.0 to 2.8 (Adjustable based on barrier needs)

Surface Tension

>40 dynes/cm (Standard for printing/lamination)

Core Advantages

  • Superior Yield: Because it is so thin, 6-micron film provides a much higher "square-meter-per-kilogram" yield compared to standard 10 or 12-micron films, making it highly cost-effective for high-volume runs.
  • High Barrier Properties: The aluminum layer acts as a shield against oxygen, moisture, and light, significantly extending the shelf life of sensitive products.
  • Thermal Stability: BOPET maintains its dimensions and strength even at high temperatures, which is critical during the high-speed lamination or printing process.
  • Flexibility: The ultra-thin nature allows it to conform to complex shapes better than thicker foils or films.

Primary Applications

1. Flexible Packaging (Lamination)

This film is rarely used alone; it is typically the middle layer in a multi-layer laminate.

  • Example Structure: PET (Outer)/6um VMPET (Barrier)/PE (Sealant).
  • Used for snacks, powdered milk, and coffee packaging where a high moisture barrier is non-negotiable.

2. Yarn & Textiles (Metallic Thread)

6-micron film is a preferred choice for producing Lurex or metallic yarns. The film is slit into incredibly narrow ribbons and twisted with fibers like cotton or polyester to create glittery, decorative textiles.

3. Insulation & Thermal Control

Used in the manufacturing of "space blankets," radiant barriers for construction, and cryogenic insulation. It reflects up to 97% of radiant heat.

Handling Challenges

Due to its extreme thinness, 6-micron film requires precise tension control on machinery. It is more prone to:

  1. Web Breaks: High-speed converting requires sophisticated equipment to prevent snapping the film.
  2. Wrinkling: Small misalignments in rollers can cause permanent increases in the thin material.
  3. Static Charge: Thin polyester is highly prone to static buildup, often requiring active de-ionizing bars during processing.

items.title: BOPP Film (3-75 microns)
items.description:
BOPP Film (3-75 microns)

BOPP film (BOPP FOIL) is a packing film with a superior mechanical nature, transparent and moisture proof formed through the processing of draft Bi-axially Oriented Polypropylene (BOPP) vertically and horizontally.
BOPP film including BOPP plain film ( BOPP flower film,BOPP tape-grade film,BOPP clothes/bag-grade film,BOPP mini/smaller roll,BOPP anti-static film);BOPP tobacco film; BOPP heat sealable film;BOPP matte film; BOPP pearlized film;BOPP thermal film; BOPP capacitor film;BOPP Sheets; BOPP anti-fog film; BOPP micro/ macro perforated film; Metallized BOPP film (VMBOPP); BOPP tear tape;BOPP laser film and so on. Featuring details :
Main Properties,High transparency and gloss
High tensile strength,High grease barrier
Excellent ink and coating adhesion,Low static electricity
Superior thickness uniformity,Smooth rolling and neat ends of film rolls
Specifications:Thickness:12-52 micron  Width:350-1600 mm Length:1000-18000M
BOPP film (Polypropylene film) is widely used for plain, lamination, matte and metalized films which are used for many different sorts selection of applications,such as carton box, flower, gift,  food, confectionery, lamination,CD,DVD, VCD,cigarette,and box packaging, packing tape, etc according to its purpose such as printing, clothes, tape and laminating which are used for many different sorts of applications as the selection follow. Customized dimensions and specifications are available upon request.
items.descriptionZh:
BOPP平膜（3-75微米）
BOPP膜厂是资金、技术、原料和劳动力的堆积。  

    建造一条拉膜线要耗费的资金大约是人民币1个亿，设计产能是2.5万吨/年。以机器的灵敏度分为电工膜拉膜线和包装膜拉膜线。
    电工膜拉膜线，无论在原料上（粒子）还是在工艺上(制造）都比包装膜线要高档的多。 电工膜拉膜线生产的是3微米到15、18微米的BOPP膜，注重膜的均匀程度，分为普通光膜和粗化膜。由于他用在电子元器件方面，所以它常常要镀铝后使用。因此电工膜拉膜线厂通常配有自己的镀铝设备，或者配套专业的镀铝厂。
    电工膜具体一点又叫做电容膜，是做有机薄膜电容器的材料。所以能拉出来厚度只有3-4个微米，又可以在上面电镀锌铝，作为电子产品的核心原料和质量保证，并占有这个产品成本的80%左右，确实是BOPP膜一个最有价值的利用，也是实实在在的纳米技术了，因为膜本身是3-4个微米，而电镀锌铝的厚度只有0.07个微米。做电容的BOPP膜要做到薄层强化效应，所以对膜自身均匀要求的很高、很严格。
    包装膜拉膜线12微米到75微米的BOPP膜，分为普通膜和热封膜，特种膜。因为是包装用途， 所以强调的是透明、可印刷、热封等，BOPP膜也用于纸塑复合，镀铝，涂胶等。包装膜，以其强大的广泛的用途，备受关注。薄光膜用于纸塑复合，包括12、15、18微米的消光。23-38微米的胶带膜、制袋膜用途广泛。珠光膜被工厂设为大量的首要的制造。镀铝、涂胶等更是在下游工厂普遍开工。整个BOPP行业的从业工厂遍地开花。
    BOPP以其高昂的利润，在过去的很长时间里供求关系稳定，新增需求持续，膜厂满负荷开工。原料（粒子）是主要的价格决定因素。今天的OPP市场，一年内狂涨狂跌，如此庞大的资金和技术的聚合体，在PP粒子的价格剧烈波动下，在经济衰退所导致的有效需求疲软条件下，BOPP市场所显示的不成熟和不稳定在每天的BOPP膜厂报价中和BOPP消息资讯里都可以了解到，在每笔订单里都可以切肤的感觉到。现在的工厂成本价格和市场价格不知道其接近的水平，但是就鄙人在商场的经历来说，有以下几点想法：
    1. OPP光膜因为原料的价格下降到底端，原料（尽管他对OPP的价格有基础性的价格决定作用）现在所决定的价格下线可能已经达到市场想要接受的最低限度，粒子市场价格的下滑，如不是大起大落，很难在普遍的国内市场起到向下导向的作用，尽管有许多的（包括工厂某些价格冲动者）观察者，见到粒子市场升降就对国内的行情加以升降，结果真实的市场却并非如此。我认为原因是粒子的价格下降到了靠劳动价格优势所不能显示的地步了。这样单纯的OPP光膜和大母卷在外销市场就显得很苍白了，他所依赖的完全是国内巨大的充足的市场活力，很大一部分是表现在直接的需求上。
    2.就鄙人的观点，膜厂如果能增加对简单2次加工（或者深加工的）如分切，涂胶，镀铝，印刷和在特殊包装等工序，则可以实现意想不到的效果。比如：BOPP膜卖不动，在BOPP上镀铝，这样就等于销售自己的光膜，镀铝这时候虽然等于白送或者甚至折价提供，但光膜的销量是保住了，利润也就能实现了。
    3.对于一些深加工光膜，我还想深入一点：在全球工业转移面前，BOPP行业里深加工产品是中国大陆这个劳动和资金密集集中体现的行业代表---BOPP深加工产品迎来即便是在今天经济严重萧条和衰退的背景下依然可以以极大的优势来正常的快速扩充。自动化，特别是完全的自动化，是产业转移相对要滞后的，原因是高科技术在支撑；半自动化的产品， 就不一样了，一边是产品的资金密集内在的要求时刻要能有高的产出和源源不断的利润来支撑，一边是产品的身后，还有庞大的配件来组成成品，密集的劳动在后半段疯狂的使用，可变资本以工资形式不断的对外释放，产业的转移----寻求低的成本也就走向必然。BOPP深加工产品在这个是这类情况最好的体现。布鲁克拉和三菱的拉膜线高频的对外界输出，辐射到发展中国家是在上世纪60年代以后的近30-40年，雨后春笋的膜厂似乎要让世界蒙上他所释放的透明的面装。世界的经济持续发展使得对包装的需求越益日常化，和吃饭穿衣一样的平常。第三产业的壮大有给包装行业插上了一个加速器和助推器的翅膀。发达国家在很大程度上依赖BOPP加工产品的包装的客观需求基础上，却要面对它的转移，这给国内BOPP原膜相对充足，和劳动力资源相对低廉，在已有的工厂扩大产品的下游种类，或者把这些下游产品独立出来，都是很容易做到的。这种既要依靠大型设备又要依靠很大人力的产品就历史的不可转移的落到了像中国这样的极符合条件的国家。所以深加工产品可以给工厂一个新的高利润增长点。许多厂家都已经在深加工产品上做出来骄人成绩。具体到BOPP的深加工产品，在市场上大概有：分切，
    1）分切成卷宽在350MM以下，这样有很大一部分单子，因为源头厂（就是膜厂不能提供）被踢到下游分切厂，这样厂一转移，原来做手册的源头厂把这个极大的，可以有超常的利润空间的产品给轻易的踢出去了，这一脚，踢得不是购买者，却是市场，在下游的分切厂里，因为退税只有5个点，他们是已人民币来购买的膜厂的母卷，这样膜厂可以延伸提供的超常的优势一下子就荡然无存。损失是净的，没有给任何一方带来实惠，白白的给损失了，因此，因此利润在这里滑落，实在应该引起膜厂的尽可能注意。
    2）大卷分切成小卷，小卷采用新的包装方式。有2种情况：第一是短米，你膜厂一般提供390-450MM的外盘经（内径76MM）。这样膜的长度在4000-6000M左右，有一部分单子是要求1000M和2000M的，这样膜厂因为计算损耗而不能接单，造成稳定的单子擦肩而过，其实，往往是规格稍微特殊一点又在一定的量上的单子稳定性也好。第二是限宽，就是宽度是在150-350MM之间，这样给分切带来不仅是损耗上，也是在工时上，有很多厂说是二次分切或者是小分切，再分切。因此真正接单的工厂也不是很多。
    3）分切成片膜，就是把大卷膜按照给定的长宽尺寸分切成一页一页的，片状的膜。分切片膜是很多工厂不愿意做的事情，认为这个是标准的下游产品，应该交给下游供应商来完成，这样下游的厂就显得很不规范和齐全了，透明的片膜是下游厂得心应手的产品，但是往往遇到印刷单色或者多色小花的图案，就给订单的谈判和交货日期带来很多的额外的麻烦，或者是印刷的要求不对，（例如颜色深浅或者尺寸的排列）或者是分切片膜的厂拿到印刷厂去再次加工。还有， 在片膜的包装上也是参差不齐 ，包装各异。有时不能满足。
    4）分切后的小卷或者片膜，印刷，镀铝，镭射，和甚至涂胶。
    印刷，在小卷或者片膜上印刷图案，这个工序很多膜厂能做，包括卷径的1英寸 1.5英寸 2英寸都能满足的很好，包装也很成熟。小卷膜的用处很多，也很受膜厂的青睐。
    涂胶，涂布水溶性的胶水做封箱胶带的，涂布PVDC阻隔，涂布丙烯酸，涂布EVA做预涂膜等。
    镀铝，镀铝成银白色的膜，增强对包装物的密封。
    镭射,全息，防伪等彩虹膜。
    5)  在包装等工序，采用特殊的包装形式用在特定的场合。
    以上是我们这些市场的经历者，在实践中所感到的微浅的意识。还存在错误观点的人们，应当改变过来。特别的厂里的决策者，不要对一个貌似不切实际的问题总是采取轻慢的态度和报以否定观，要能见冰山之一角而对其发展的趋势做出果断的敏锐的把握，不要让不易的市场在竞争中失之交臂。因为发展的概念里包涵者深化已有的产品来自我更新，在衰退的经济中不断稳定自己的位置并继续向前。

    BOPP以其高昂的利润，在过去的很长时间里供求关系稳定，新增需求持续，膜厂满负荷开工。原料（粒子）是主要的价格决定因素。今天的OPP市场，一年内狂涨狂跌，如此庞大的资金和技术的聚合体，在PP粒子的价格剧烈波动下，在经济衰退所导致的有效需求疲软条件下，BOPP市场所显示的不成熟和不稳定在每天的BOPP膜厂报价中和BOPP消息资讯里都可以了解到，在每笔订单里都可以切肤的感觉到。现在的工厂成本价格和市场价格不知道其接近的水平，但是就鄙人在商场的经历来说，有以下几点想法：
    1. OPP光膜因为原料的价格下降到底端，原料（尽管他对OPP的价格有基础性的价格决定作用）现在所决定的价格下线可能已经达到市场想要接受的最低限度，粒子市场价格的下滑，如不是大起大落，很难在普遍的国内市场起到向下导向的作用，尽管有许多的（包括工厂某些价格冲动者）观察者，见到粒子市场升降就对国内的行情加以升降，结果真实的市场却并非如此。我认为原因是粒子的价格下降到了靠劳动价格优势所不能显示的地步了。这样单纯的OPP光膜和大母卷在外销市场就显得很苍白了，他所依赖的完全是国内巨大的充足的市场活力，很大一部分是表现在直接的需求上。
    2.就鄙人的观点，膜厂如果能增加对简单2次加工（或者深加工的）如分切，涂胶，镀铝，印刷和在特殊包装等工序，则可以实现意想不到的效果。比如：BOPP膜卖不动，在BOPP上镀铝，这样就等于销售自己的光膜，镀铝这时候虽然等于白送或者甚至折价提供，但光膜的销量是保住了，利润也就能实现了。
    3.对于一些深加工光膜，我还想深入一点：在全球工业转移面前，BOPP行业里深加工产品是中国大陆这个劳动和资金密集集中体现的行业代表---BOPP深加工产品迎来即便是在今天经济严重萧条和衰退的背景下依然可以以极大的优势来正常的快速扩充。自动化，特别是完全的自动化，是产业转移相对要滞后的，原因是高科技术在支撑；半自动化的产品， 就不一样了，一边是产品的资金密集内在的要求时刻要能有高的产出和源源不断的利润来支撑，一边是产品的身后，还有庞大的配件来组成成品，密集的劳动在后半段疯狂的使用，可变资本以工资形式不断的对外释放，产业的转移----寻求低的成本也就走向必然。BOPP深加工产品在这个是这类情况最好的体现。布鲁克拉和三菱的拉膜线高频的对外界输出，辐射到发展中国家是在上世纪60年代以后的近30-40年，雨后春笋的膜厂似乎要让世界蒙上他所释放的透明的面装。世界的经济持续发展使得对包装的需求越益日常化，和吃饭穿衣一样的平常。第三产业的壮大有给包装行业插上了一个加速器和助推器的翅膀。发达国家在很大程度上依赖BOPP加工产品的包装的客观需求基础上，却要面对它的转移，这给国内BOPP原膜相对充足，和劳动力资源相对低廉，在已有的工厂扩大产品的下游种类，或者把这些下游产品独立出来，都是很容易做到的。这种既要依靠大型设备又要依靠很大人力的产品就历史的不可转移的落到了像中国这样的极符合条件的国家。所以深加工产品可以给工厂一个新的高利润增长点。许多厂家都已经在深加工产品上做出来骄人成绩。具体到BOPP的深加工产品，在市场上大概有：分切，
    1）分切成卷宽在350MM以下，这样有很大一部分单子，因为源头厂（就是膜厂不能提供）被踢到下游分切厂，这样厂一转移，原来做手册的源头厂把这个极大的，可以有超常的利润空间的产品给轻易的踢出去了，这一脚，踢得不是购买者，却是市场，在下游的分切厂里，因为退税只有5个点，他们是已人民币来购买的膜厂的母卷，这样膜厂可以延伸提供的超常的优势一下子就荡然无存。损失是净的，没有给任何一方带来实惠，白白的给损失了，因此，因此利润在这里滑落，实在应该引起膜厂的尽可能注意。
    2）大卷分切成小卷，小卷采用新的包装方式。有2种情况：第一是短米，你膜厂一般提供390-450MM的外盘经（内径76MM）。这样膜的长度在4000-6000M左右，有一部分单子是要求1000M和2000M的，这样膜厂因为计算损耗而不能接单，造成稳定的单子擦肩而过，其实，往往是规格稍微特殊一点又在一定的量上的单子稳定性也好。第二是限宽，就是宽度是在150-350MM之间，这样给分切带来不仅是损耗上，也是在工时上，有很多厂说是二次分切或者是小分切，再分切。因此真正接单的工厂也不是很多。
    3）分切成片膜，就是把大卷膜按照给定的长宽尺寸分切成一页一页的，片状的膜。分切片膜是很多工厂不愿意做的事情，认为这个是标准的下游产品，应该交给下游供应商来完成，这样下游的厂就显得很不规范和齐全了，透明的片膜是下游厂得心应手的产品，但是往往遇到印刷单色或者多色小花的图案，就给订单的谈判和交货日期带来很多的额外的麻烦，或者是印刷的要求不对，（例如颜色深浅或者尺寸的排列）或者是分切片膜的厂拿到印刷厂去再次加工。还有， 在片膜的包装上也是参差不齐 ，包装各异。有时不能满足。
    4）分切后的小卷或者片膜，印刷，镀铝，镭射，和甚至涂胶。
    印刷，在小卷或者片膜上印刷图案，这个工序很多膜厂能做，包括卷径的1英寸 1.5英寸 2英寸都能满足的很好，包装也很成熟。小卷膜的用处很多，也很受膜厂的青睐。
    涂胶，涂布水溶性的胶水做封箱胶带的，涂布PVDC阻隔，涂布丙烯酸，涂布EVA做预涂膜等。
    镀铝，镀铝成银白色的膜，增强对包装物的密封。
    镭射,全息，防伪等彩虹膜。
    5)  在包装等工序，采用特殊的包装形式用在特定的场合。
    以上是我们这些市场的经历者，在实践中所感到的微浅的意识。还存在错误观点的人们，应当改变过来。特别的厂里的决策者，不要对一个貌似不切实际的问题总是采取轻慢的态度和报以否定观，要能见冰山之一角而对其发展的趋势做出果断的敏锐的把握，不要让不易的市场在竞争中失之交臂。因为发展的概念里包涵者深化已有的产品来自我更新，在衰退的经济中不断稳定自己的位置并继续向前。

3）分切成片膜，就是把大卷膜按照给定的长宽尺寸分切成一页一页的，片状的膜。分切片膜是很多工厂不愿意做的事情，认为这个是标准的下游产品，应该交给下游供应商来完成，这样下游的厂就显得很不规范和齐全了，透明的片膜是下游厂得心应手的产品，但是往往遇到印刷单色或者多色小花的图案，就给订单的谈判和交货日期带来很多的额外的麻烦，或者是印刷的要求不对，（例如颜色深浅或者尺寸的排列）或者是分切片膜的厂拿到印刷厂去再次加工。还有， 在片膜的包装上也是参差不齐 ，包装各异。有时不能满足。

4）分切后的小卷或者片膜，印刷，镀铝，镭射，和甚至涂胶。

印刷，在小卷或者片膜上印刷图案，这个工序很多膜厂能做，包括卷径的1英寸 1.5英寸 2英寸都能满足的很好，包装也很成熟。小卷膜的用处很多，也很受膜厂的青睐。

涂胶，涂布水溶性的胶水做封箱胶带的，涂布PVDC阻隔，涂布丙烯酸，涂布EVA做预涂膜等。

镀铝，镀铝成银白色的膜，增强对包装物的密封。

镭射,全息，防伪等彩虹膜。

5)  在包装等工序，采用特殊的包装形式用在特定的场合。

以上是我们这些市场的经历者，在实践中所感到的微浅的意识。还存在错误观点的人们，应当改变过来。特别的厂里的决策者，不要对一个貌似不切实际的问题总是采取轻慢的态度和报以否定观，要能见冰山之一角而对其发展的趋势做出果断的敏锐的把握，不要让不易的市场在竞争中失之交臂。因为发展的概念里包涵者深化已有的产品来自我更新，在衰退的经济中不断稳定自己的位置并继续向前。

items.bodyHtmlZh:
聚丙烯薄膜

BOPP膜厂是资金、技术、原料和劳动力的堆积。

建造一条拉膜线要耗费的资金大约是人民币1个亿，设计产能是2.5万吨/年。以机器的灵敏度分为电工膜拉膜线和包装膜拉膜线。

电工膜拉膜线，无论在原料上（粒子）还是在工艺上(制造）都比包装膜线要高档的多。 电工膜拉膜线生产的是3微米到15、18微米的BOPP膜，注重膜的均匀程度，分为普通光膜和粗化膜。由于他用在电子元器件方面，所以它常常要镀铝后使用。因此电工膜拉膜线厂通常配有自己的镀铝设备，或者配套专业的镀铝厂。

电工膜具体一点又叫做电容膜，是做有机薄膜电容器的材料。所以能拉出来厚度只有3-4个微米，又可以在上面电镀锌铝，作为电子产品的核心原料和质量保证，并占有这个产品成本的80%左右，确实是BOPP膜一个最有价值的利用，也是实实在在的纳米技术了，因为膜本身是3-4个微米，而电镀锌铝的厚度只有0.07个微米。做电容的BOPP膜要做到薄层强化效应，所以对膜自身均匀要求的很高、很严格。

包装膜拉膜线12微米到75微米的BOPP膜，分为普通膜和热封膜，特种膜。因为是包装用途， 所以强调的是透明、可印刷、热封等，BOPP膜也用于纸塑复合，镀铝，涂胶等。包装膜，以其强大的广泛的用途，备受关注。薄光膜用于纸塑复合，包括12、15、18微米的消光。23-38微米的胶带膜、制袋膜用途广泛。珠光膜被工厂设为大量的首要的制造。镀铝、涂胶等更是在下游工厂普遍开工。整个BOPP行业的从业工厂遍地开花。

BOPP以其高昂的利润，在过去的很长时间里供求关系稳定，新增需求持续，膜厂满负荷开工。原料（粒子）是主要的价格决定因素。今天的OPP市场，一年内狂涨狂跌，如此庞大的资金和技术的聚合体，在PP粒子的价格剧烈波动下，在经济衰退所导致的有效需求疲软条件下，BOPP市场所显示的不成熟和不稳定在每天的BOPP膜厂报价中和BOPP消息资讯里都可以了解到，在每笔订单里都可以切肤的感觉到。现在的工厂成本价格和市场价格不知道其接近的水平，但是就鄙人在商场的经历来说，有以下几点想法：

1. OPP光膜因为原料的价格下降到底端，原料（尽管他对OPP的价格有基础性的价格决定作用）现在所决定的价格下线可能已经达到市场想要接受的最低限度，粒子市场价格的下滑，如不是大起大落，很难在普遍的国内市场起到向下导向的作用，尽管有许多的（包括工厂某些价格冲动者）观察者，见到粒子市场升降就对国内的行情加以升降，结果真实的市场却并非如此。我认为原因是粒子的价格下降到了靠劳动价格优势所不能显示的地步了。这样单纯的OPP光膜和大母卷在外销市场就显得很苍白了，他所依赖的完全是国内巨大的充足的市场活力，很大一部分是表现在直接的需求上。

2.就鄙人的观点，膜厂如果能增加对简单2次加工（或者深加工的）如分切，涂胶，镀铝，印刷和在特殊包装等工序，则可以实现意想不到的效果。比如：BOPP膜卖不动，在BOPP上镀铝，这样就等于销售自己的光膜，镀铝这时候虽然等于白送或者甚至折价提供，但光膜的销量是保住了，利润也就能实现了。

3.对于一些深加工光膜，我还想深入一点：在全球工业转移面前，BOPP行业里深加工产品是中国大陆这个劳动和资金密集集中体现的行业代表---BOPP深加工产品迎来即便是在今天经济严重萧条和衰退的背景下依然可以以极大的优势来正常的快速扩充。自动化，特别是完全的自动化，是产业转移相对要滞后的，原因是高科技术在支撑；半自动化的产品， 就不一样了，一边是产品的资金密集内在的要求时刻要能有高的产出和源源不断的利润来支撑，一边是产品的身后，还有庞大的配件来组成成品，密集的劳动在后半段疯狂的使用，可变资本以工资形式不断的对外释放，产业的转移----寻求低的成本也就走向必然。BOPP深加工产品在这个是这类情况最好的体现。布鲁克拉和三菱的拉膜线高频的对外界输出，辐射到发展中国家是在上世纪60年代以后的近30-40年，雨后春笋的膜厂似乎要让世界蒙上他所释放的透明的面装。世界的经济持续发展使得对包装的需求越益日常化，和吃饭穿衣一样的平常。第三产业的壮大有给包装行业插上了一个加速器和助推器的翅膀。发达国家在很大程度上依赖BOPP加工产品的包装的客观需求基础上，却要面对它的转移，这给国内BOPP原膜相对充足，和劳动力资源相对低廉，在已有的工厂扩大产品的下游种类，或者把这些下游产品独立出来，都是很容易做到的。这种既要依靠大型设备又要依靠很大人力的产品就历史的不可转移的落到了像中国这样的极符合条件的国家。所以深加工产品可以给工厂一个新的高利润增长点。许多厂家都已经在深加工产品上做出来骄人成绩。具体到BOPP的深加工产品，在市场上大概有：分切，

5)  在包装等工序，采用特殊的包装形式用在特定的场合。

以上是我们这些市场的经历者，在实践中所感到的微浅的意识。还存在错误观点的人们，应当改变过来。特别的厂里的决策者，不要对一个貌似不切实际的问题总是采取轻慢的态度和报以否定观，要能见冰山之一角而对其发展的趋势做出果断的敏锐的把握，不要让不易的市场在竞争中失之交臂。因为发展的概念里包涵者深化已有的产品来自我更新，在衰退的经济中不断稳定自己的位置并继续向前。

items.descriptionZh:
BOPP 印刷复合膜

一、BOPP 平膜

较成熟, 标准化程度高, 目前占国内市场约70%, 主要分为印刷复合膜、胶粘带膜和制袋膜, 但仍有多种用户认可的差异化途径:

1 高透明( 雾度≤0.3) 、高光泽( 光泽度≥99%) , 应用于超透明胶粘带、与纸类制品复合等;

2 低静电( ≤1013) , 用于电子元件包装、适宜复合切片堆叠和自动化包装等;

3 耐磨花( ≥20S, 普通膜≤3S) , 用于直接制冷封袋或针织品包装等;

4 电晕值长效( 6 个月≥42mN/m) , 适宜产品出口, 用于高速印刷、复合、涂布等;

5 浅网印刷, 要求表面微观平整, 电晕值高;

6 高挺度, 质感好, 可减少薄膜厚度, 降低成本;

7 开口性好, 便于产品包装;

8 疵点少, 1000m2 中不允许有大于Φ1.0mm 疵点, Φ0.5- 1.0mm 的疵点≤2 个;

二、BOPP 热封膜

应用于印刷、复合制袋或盒体保护等方面。◆ 超低温起封或宽热封温度范围( 80-135℃) , 高爽滑( COF≤0.25) , 高电晕保持值( 6 个月≥42mN/m) , 适用于高速印刷复合包装或性能差异大的包装设备;

1 低静电, 用于粉剂包装;

2 高热封强度( 5- 12N/15mm) , 取代复合膜直接印刷制袋;

3 高挺度, 提高包装速度, 减少厚度;

4 吸管专用包装膜, 适宜的透明度、光泽度、摩擦系数和热封强度。

三、BOPP 消光膜

常用于书册、广告册、礼品袋、食品包装等, 外观有立体感。

1 外观无疵点, 适宜与深色纸类制品复合;

2 镀铝附着力强, 上色镀铝具有丝绸质感;

3 上UV 油墨或烫金加工性能好

4 高挺度, 可减少厚度, 易于复合加工。

四、BOPP 烟膜

可用于香烟、医药和化装品等盒体的外包装。

1 高挺度, 弹性模量:MD≥3000MPa,TD≥5000MPa;

2 高爽滑, COF≤0.2;

3 高透明, 雾度≤0.7%, 高光泽≥99%;

4 耐磨花

5 热封温度范围广

6 收缩烟膜印刷或涂布性能好。五、BOPP 拉线膜

用于盒体外包装膜的撕裂线。

1 保持高的后加工热收缩, MD≥5.5%;

2 易于印刷、镀铝和涂布加工;

六、BOPP 珠光膜

用于雪糕、糖果、香皂、洗衣粉、筷子等物品的包装以及环型标签。

1 单位面积重量均匀, 稳定, 密度≤0.7g/cm3

2 透光率≤48%, 白度≥88%

3 热封强度≥1.2N/15mm;

4 耐寒性好;

5 环型标签膜: 高挺度、低静电、高光泽、高白度、珠光色泽好、良好的印刷复合性能。

七、BOPP 合成纸

产品特点: 防水、耐撕, 优良的加工适应性, 适用于凸版、凹版、平版、网版等印刷和烫金、钻孔等天然纸的后加工过程, 由单一材质制成, 可回收使用, 密度低。

应用: 电脑喷绘底纸、复合原料包装袋、名片、网印海报、餐桌布、地图、商业平版印刷海报、礼品包装纸、防潮布、杂志、书刊用纸、花卉包装纸、面材保护纸、吊牌、标签( 特别是模内标签膜) 、礼品袋等。

1 良好的遮光度: 透光率≤32%;

2 高白度: ≥88%;

3 密度: 0.55- 0.80g/cm3

4 表印性能优越, 耐磨花;

5 尺寸稳定性好

6 良好的耐候性

八、BOPP 镀铝膜基材

经蒸镀后的薄膜具有金属般光泽的表面和良好的阻隔性( 气体、光线等) , 有特殊的装饰效果, 可用于许多食品( 如茶叶、饼干、干果等) 的包装。

1 镀铝附着力强

2 高光泽度≥96%

3 高刚性

4 可热封: 3- 7N/15mm, 高热封强度, 可取代CPP 镀铝复合膜

5 高阻隔性能, 透湿: ≤0.8g/m2.24h透氧: ≤3cc/m2.24h

九、BOPP 镭射膜( 激光模压膜)

非转移镭射膜模压或镀铝后模压与纸制品或薄膜复合或直接用于烟盒、药盒、化装品盒、食品盒或袋的包装等。可转移镭射膜, 产品模压镀铝涂胶后与卡纸复合剥离转移再表印加工用作防伪香烟盒或药盒等包装; 与热封薄膜复合后剥离转移, 用作防伪食品等包装。

1.尺寸稳定性好, 模压性能佳;

2.模压膜面外观清晰, 亮点或疵点少;

3 后加工适应性好;

4 产品模压后出现的全息光栅衍射强度均一、稳定;

5 转移膜: 品模压镀铝转移完全, 剥离速度快, 无反粘等异常现象, 产品模压镀铝较长时间仍能保持良好转移效果, 可印刷性好。十、BOPP 扭结膜

用于糖果扭结包装, 环保卫生方面取代PVC 材料, 价格方面优于BOPS、BOPET 扭结膜和玻璃纸。

1 挺度高、刚性强

, , , , ,    2 高光泽

3 镀铝附着力强

4 扭结性能好, 回弹少。

十一、BOPP 防雾膜( 抗菌、透气)

用于新鲜水果、蔬菜、色拉、食用菌等包装, 冷藏时清晰看到内容物, 并防止食品变质腐烂。

1 防雾效果好( 冷热状态可防雾)

2 透气: ≥4000cc/m2.24h

3 热封性能好

4 柔软

十二、BOPP 离型膜

取代BOPET、CPP 等直接制作或背涂硅油用于医药、无声胶粘带和其它涂胶产品的保护。

1 高挺度

2 外观疵点少

3 热尺寸稳定性好

十三、BOPP 缠绕膜

用于钓鱼杆、高尔夫球杆、其它工业制品的保护。

1.拉伸强度高

2.尺寸稳定性好

3.外观疵点少

十四、BOPP 电容器薄膜

1 金属化电容器薄膜: 耐高温( ≥105℃) ,用于汽车电池、灯具等的用品的电容器。

2 薄型化

十五、其它差异化用途

1. 极低气味BOPP 薄膜: 减少对食品气味的污染或干扰;

2. 耐温、阻燃BOPP 薄膜: 电路板或元件干燥固化

3. 抗撕裂BOPP 薄膜: 取代复合膜

4. 低移转BOPP 薄膜: 减少内容物的污染, 适宜高

items.bodyHtmlZh:
BOPP 印刷复合膜

一、BOPP 平膜

较成熟, 标准化程度高, 目前占国内市场约70%, 主要分为印刷复合膜、胶粘带膜和制袋膜, 但仍有多种用户认可的差异化途径:

1 高透明( 雾度≤0.3) 、高光泽( 光泽度≥99%) , 应用于超透明胶粘带、与纸类制品复合等;

2 低静电( ≤1013) , 用于电子元件包装、适宜复合切片堆叠和自动化包装等;

3 耐磨花( ≥20S, 普通膜≤3S) , 用于直接制冷封袋或针织品包装等;

4 电晕值长效( 6 个月≥42mN/m) , 适宜产品出口, 用于高速印刷、复合、涂布等;

5 浅网印刷, 要求表面微观平整, 电晕值高;

6 高挺度, 质感好, 可减少薄膜厚度, 降低成本;

7 开口性好, 便于产品包装;

8 疵点少, 1000m2 中不允许有大于Φ1.0mm 疵点, Φ0.5- 1.0mm 的疵点≤2 个;

二、BOPP 热封膜

应用于印刷、复合制袋或盒体保护等方面。◆ 超低温起封或宽热封温度范围( 80-135℃) , 高爽滑( COF≤0.25) , 高电晕保持值( 6 个月≥42mN/m) , 适用于高速印刷复合包装或性能差异大的包装设备;

1 低静电, 用于粉剂包装;

2 高热封强度( 5- 12N/15mm) , 取代复合膜直接印刷制袋;

3 高挺度, 提高包装速度, 减少厚度;

4 吸管专用包装膜, 适宜的透明度、光泽度、摩擦系数和热封强度。

三、BOPP 消光膜

常用于书册、广告册、礼品袋、食品包装等, 外观有立体感。

1 外观无疵点, 适宜与深色纸类制品复合;

2 镀铝附着力强, 上色镀铝具有丝绸质感;

3 上UV 油墨或烫金加工性能好

4 高挺度, 可减少厚度, 易于复合加工。

四、BOPP 烟膜

可用于香烟、医药和化装品等盒体的外包装。

1 高挺度, 弹性模量:MD≥3000MPa,TD≥5000MPa;

2 高爽滑, COF≤0.2;

3 高透明, 雾度≤0.7%, 高光泽≥99%;

4 耐磨花

5 热封温度范围广

6 收缩烟膜印刷或涂布性能好。五、BOPP 拉线膜

用于盒体外包装膜的撕裂线。

1 保持高的后加工热收缩, MD≥5.5%;

2 易于印刷、镀铝和涂布加工;

六、BOPP 珠光膜

用于雪糕、糖果、香皂、洗衣粉、筷子等物品的包装以及环型标签。

1 单位面积重量均匀, 稳定, 密度≤0.7g/cm3

2 透光率≤48%, 白度≥88%

3 热封强度≥1.2N/15mm;

4 耐寒性好;

5 环型标签膜: 高挺度、低静电、高光泽、高白度、珠光色泽好、良好的印刷复合性能。

七、BOPP 合成纸

产品特点: 防水、耐撕, 优良的加工适应性, 适用于凸版、凹版、平版、网版等印刷和烫金、钻孔等天然纸的后加工过程, 由单一材质制成, 可回收使用, 密度低。

应用: 电脑喷绘底纸、复合原料包装袋、名片、网印海报、餐桌布、地图、商业平版印刷海报、礼品包装纸、防潮布、杂志、书刊用纸、花卉包装纸、面材保护纸、吊牌、标签( 特别是模内标签膜) 、礼品袋等。

1 良好的遮光度: 透光率≤32%;

2 高白度: ≥88%;

3 密度: 0.55- 0.80g/cm3

4 表印性能优越, 耐磨花;

5 尺寸稳定性好

6 良好的耐候性

八、BOPP 镀铝膜基材

经蒸镀后的薄膜具有金属般光泽的表面和良好的阻隔性( 气体、光线等) , 有特殊的装饰效果, 可用于许多食品( 如茶叶、饼干、干果等) 的包装。

1 镀铝附着力强

2 高光泽度≥96%

3 高刚性

4 可热封: 3- 7N/15mm, 高热封强度, 可取代CPP 镀铝复合膜

5 高阻隔性能, 透湿: ≤0.8g/m2.24h透氧: ≤3cc/m2.24h

九、BOPP 镭射膜( 激光模压膜)

非转移镭射膜模压或镀铝后模压与纸制品或薄膜复合或直接用于烟盒、药盒、化装品盒、食品盒或袋的包装等。可转移镭射膜, 产品模压镀铝涂胶后与卡纸复合剥离转移再表印加工用作防伪香烟盒或药盒等包装; 与热封薄膜复合后剥离转移, 用作防伪食品等包装。

1.尺寸稳定性好, 模压性能佳;

2.模压膜面外观清晰, 亮点或疵点少;

3 后加工适应性好;

4 产品模压后出现的全息光栅衍射强度均一、稳定;

5 转移膜: 品模压镀铝转移完全, 剥离速度快, 无反粘等异常现象, 产品模压镀铝较长时间仍能保持良好转移效果, 可印刷性好。十、BOPP 扭结膜

用于糖果扭结包装, 环保卫生方面取代PVC 材料, 价格方面优于BOPS、BOPET 扭结膜和玻璃纸。

1 挺度高、刚性强

, , , , ,    2 高光泽

3 镀铝附着力强

4 扭结性能好, 回弹少。

十一、BOPP 防雾膜( 抗菌、透气)

用于新鲜水果、蔬菜、色拉、食用菌等包装, 冷藏时清晰看到内容物, 并防止食品变质腐烂。

1 防雾效果好( 冷热状态可防雾)

2 透气: ≥4000cc/m2.24h

3 热封性能好

4 柔软

十二、BOPP 离型膜

取代BOPET、CPP 等直接制作或背涂硅油用于医药、无声胶粘带和其它涂胶产品的保护。

1 高挺度

2 外观疵点少

3 热尺寸稳定性好

十三、BOPP 缠绕膜

用于钓鱼杆、高尔夫球杆、其它工业制品的保护。

1.拉伸强度高

2.尺寸稳定性好

3.外观疵点少

十四、BOPP 电容器薄膜

1 金属化电容器薄膜: 耐高温( ≥105℃) ,用于汽车电池、灯具等的用品的电容器。

2 薄型化

Low static electricity,Superior thickness uniformity
Smoothness of the vertical section and much compact of film rolls winding

items.offerZh:
BOPP珠光膜/BOPP white opaque film (BOPP pearlized film)

BOPP珠光膜是由双向拉伸聚丙烯薄膜制成的一种高透明、高光泽度的包装材料。它是一种经济实惠的包装材料，广泛用于食品、药品、化妆品、文具、音像制品等行业的包装，尤其是适合于需要高效率自动包装生产线的使用。

BOPP珠光膜的特点是透明度高，光泽度好，具有良好的耐热、耐湿性和机械性能，同时还具有优异的密封性和抗撕裂性能。这些特性使得BOPP珠光膜在包装行业中得到了广泛应用。

在使用BOPP珠光膜进行包装时，需要注意以下几点：

1. 要根据不同的产品选择不同类型的BOPP珠光膜，从而达到最佳的包装效果。
2. 在包装过程中，应该控制好包装机的温度，确保BOPP珠光膜的热封性能。
3. 运输和存储时，应该避免阳光直射和高温环境，以免BOPP珠光膜受热变形。

总的来说，BOPP珠光膜是一种高效的包装材料，具有优异的性能和广泛的应用前景。

items.description:
BOPP cigarette tobacco pack wrapping film (plain/shrinkage)

a.) BOPP cigarette tobacco film generally used for soft/hard tobacco pack and used for modern high/slow packing machines.
transparent biaxially oriented polypropylene cigarette film featured coextruded heat sealable on both sides,incorporated with anti- static protection
Thickness : 18,19,20,21,22,25 Microns
Width: 90,110,120,135,150,220,350MM  Length:2000,2800MM,3000,3500M
bopp tobacco film or bopp cigarette film also called as bopp shrinkage cigarette film,Polypropylene cigar film,BOPP soft cigarette pack film, BOPP hard rigit tobacco film, bopp tobacco pack film, bopp tear tape tobacco film Well-fitting to machine, suitable for high speed packing of all kinds of soft pack. Special hot slip ability on surface,can avoid machine-blocking,sticking etc. Quick heat sealing at low temperature and pressare. Good foldability after forming.  Inferior optical properties to others.
Customer's own requirement is available for us such as printed OEM logos and private label or particular size and package style.
2.Half-shrinkage BOPP Cigarette Film with heat sealable matches high-speed packaging machines.
3.High-shrinkage BOPP Cigarette Film with heat sealable matches high-speed packaging machines.
b.) BOPP shrinkage cigarette film with tear tape
BOPP shrinkage cigarette film insert the tear tape for the tobacco cigarette pack wrapping . Size : in sheets ( not in jumbo rolls or smaller rolls )  package: 1000sheets/bag (ream) , 24 reams/carton .
1. S1--- Size : 22 MICRONS *150 MM* 148 MM (37 MM+(insert) 2 MM tear tape + 109 MM .

items.description:

Thickness: 15-50UM (Microns) for example: 20 25 30 35 40 Microns

BOPP/BOPET Capacitor Film clear

Polypropylene films BOPP Dielectric grade

1) Plain & Film for making suitable for High / Extra High Voltage Capacitors

2) Plain & Hazy Corona treated suitable for metalizing for making Metalized Film Capacitors)

1. BOPP capacitor film have two items, BOPP clear capacitor film and BOPP rough clear capacitor film.
1.)M-PP for metallized -film capacitors applications .

BOPP 锌铝电容膜 (银白色)
超薄型金属化电容器用薄膜(BOPP-K 薄膜)。超薄金属化薄膜（以超薄型安全膜为主）是电力电子电容器（机车电力电子电容器、混合动力汽车电容器及高比能脉冲电容器)和薄膜器的主要原材料。  平膜法逐次双向拉伸聚丙烯的生产工艺流程如下：         原料→预处理→共挤出→铸片→急冷→         牵引→预热→纵向拉伸→横向拉伸→定型→         测厚→电晕处理→收卷→时效处理→分切→成品→
超薄型金属化电容器用薄膜(BOPP-K 膜) 是金属化薄膜电容器的主要材料，是电子整机和电器电路设备必不可少的基础元件。一
般由镀膜企业蒸镀金属后再提供给电容器生产厂制成各种不同功能的电容器。
随着电子、信息产业的应用和发展，对金属化薄膜电容器的品种、技术性能、可靠性水平、结构形状和几何尺寸及使用安全性提出了越来越高的要求。
而对于高档电容膜产品——厚度在5µm以下的超薄型BOPP-K 膜，由于薄膜电容器向大功率小型化和片式化方向发展，市场对超薄型薄膜的需求量将越来越大.
金属化膜是电容器生产的关键原材料。目前一般生产自愈式低压并联电力电容器使用Al金属化聚丙烯膜、Zn-Al（或Ag-Zn）聚丙烯金属化膜。 铝金属化膜和锌铝金属化膜的区别 在镀膜技术中，因铝膜生产成本低，对环境的适应性强，常温常湿自然条件下，可以存放较长。

items.bodyHtmlZh:
BOPP 锌铝电容膜 (银白色)
超薄型金属化电容器用薄膜(BOPP-K 薄膜)。超薄金属化薄膜（以超薄型安全膜为主）是电力电子电容器（机车电力电子电容器、混合动力汽车电容器及高比能脉冲电容器)和薄膜器的主要原材料。  平膜法逐次双向拉伸聚丙烯的生产工艺流程如下：         原料→预处理→共挤出→铸片→急冷→         牵引→预热→纵向拉伸→横向拉伸→定型→         测厚→电晕处理→收卷→时效处理→分切→成品→
超薄型金属化电容器用薄膜(BOPP-K 膜) 是金属化薄膜电容器的主要材料，是电子整机和电器电路设备必不可少的基础元件。一
般由镀膜企业蒸镀金属后再提供给电容器生产厂制成各种不同功能的电容器。
随着电子、信息产业的应用和发展，对金属化薄膜电容器的品种、技术性能、可靠性水平、结构形状和几何尺寸及使用安全性提出了越来越高的要求。
而对于高档电容膜产品——厚度在5µm以下的超薄型BOPP-K 膜，由于薄膜电容器向大功率小型化和片式化方向发展，市场对超薄型薄膜的需求量将越来越大.
金属化膜是电容器生产的关键原材料。目前一般生产自愈式低压并联电力电容器使用Al金属化聚丙烯膜、Zn-Al（或Ag-Zn）聚丙烯金属化膜。 铝金属化膜和锌铝金属化膜的区别 在镀膜技术中，因铝膜生产成本低，对环境的适应性强，常温常湿自然条件下，可以存放较长。

items.title: Polypropylene safety capacitor film
items.description:
Polypropylene safety capacitor film
Features:
The surface of film Vacuum metallized a thin electrode layer with appointed special designs , it comes true the integration of the three ,as capacitor dielectric, electrode and explosion-proof.
Do it like this , which realize a revolutionary progress of the explosion-proof mechanism.
It features electrode pattern being clear, innovative design, excellent explosion-proof performance, security and high reliability.
It used for manufacture blast-proof structure, medium and electrode material of blast-proof capacitor.
Film thickness: 2.5UM-15UM
Electrode design: grid-type, T type

BOPP  Metallized Capacitor Film (silver) . Metallized BOPP Capacitor Film (silver film) have two items :

1. Zn/Al Metallized BOPP Capacitor Film (silver film)2. Al Metallized BOPP Capacitor Film (silver film)
Metallized BOPP/BOPET Capacitor Film were also called silver pp Capacitor film, zn/al BOPP capacitor film,Polypropylene metallized Film, Zn metallized capacitor bopp film, CBB capacitor metallized film
reinforced edge ( of Aluminum/Zinc film ) are : 1.5,2.0,2.5 MM
The standard thickness range including: 3,4,5,6,7,8,9,10,12 microns .
The standard tolerance thickness: +/-0.2 Um .
The standard width range including: 30,40,50,60,70,80,90,100,120,130 MMThe standard tolerance width: +/-5 MM.
The inner core : 3" (76MM)
The outer core: 150-350 MM .
Features:1) single side corona treated for the Zn or Zn/Al metallized .

3. Featuring & Technology data:

TYPICAL VALUES AND PHYSICAL PROPERTIES

Technical requirements on metalized polypropylene film for dry-type power
capacitors
METALLIZED POLYPROPYLENE FILM BIAXIALLY ORIENTED
- Thickness – 7,5 and 10 μm,
- Width – 100 mm,
- Free margin – 2,5 mm,
- Heavy edge – yes,
- Metallization – Al + Zn with one lateral margin,
- Surface resistance - (5-10) ohms/sq in active area, (2-4) ohms/sq in heavy edge area:
- Inner diameter of core – 75 ÷ 76 mm,
- External diameter of a roll – 240 mm, approximately.
Technical requirements on biaxially oriented polypropylene (BOPP) film for impregnated
power capacitors
- Surface – smoothness or roughness,
- Thickness – 6 - 15,2 μm,
- Width – 65 - 325 mm,
- Inner diameter of core – 75 ÷ 76 mm,
- External diameter of a roll – 220 mm max,
- Spase factor – 8-10 % for roughness film,
metalized polypropylene film and biaxially oriented polypropylene (BOPP) film

2. Usage: It is widely used in capacitors lines

3. Packing : use cartons and kraft paper and bobble film to packing as inner package, and use pallets and wood board to packing as outer package

5. Packing: carton and pallets (use cartons and kraft paper and bobble film to packing as inner package, and use pallets and wood board to packing as outer package)

items.descriptionZh:
BOPP 锌铝电容膜


    基膜　base film电容器用的能在其表面蒸镀一层极薄金属层的塑料薄膜。
    金属化薄膜  metallized film

将高纯铝或锌在高真空状态下熔化、蒸发、沉淀到基膜上，在基膜表面形成一层极薄的金属层后的塑料薄膜。
    自愈作用　self-healing

金属化薄膜介质局部击穿后立即本能地恢复到击穿前的电性能现象。
    留边  margin

为实际制作电容器需要，将金属化薄膜一侧或两侧边缘或中间遮盖而形成不蒸镀金属的空白绝缘条(带)称为留边，其宽度称为留边量。
    方块电阻　square resistance

金属化薄膜上的金属层在单位正方形面积的电阻值称为方块电阻，用Ω/□表示，通常用方块电阻来表示金属镀层的厚度。
    金属化安全薄膜  metallized safe film

金属层图案含有保险丝安全结构的金属化薄膜。按保险丝安全结构特点可分网格安全膜、T形安全膜和串接安全膜等。

产品类型

MPPA（MPETA）——单面铝金属化聚丙烯（或聚酯）薄膜，

MPPAD(MPETAD)——双面铝金属化聚丙烯(或聚酯)薄膜

MPPAH(MPETAH)——边缘加厚金属层的单面铝金属化聚丙烯(或聚酯)薄膜，

MPPAZ(MPETAZ)——单面锌铝金属化聚丙烯(或聚酯)薄膜，

MPPAZHX(MPETAZHX)——边缘加厚金属层的单面锌铝金属化聚丙烯(或聚酯)网格型安全薄膜，见

MPPAT(MPETAT)——单面铝金属化聚丙烯(或聚酯)T型安全薄膜，

代号中：
M表示金属化；
PP表示聚丙烯薄膜；

PET表示聚酯薄膜；
A表示镀层金属为铝；
AZ表示镀层金属为锌铝复合；
D表示双面金属化；
H表示边缘加厚金属层；

X 表示网格安全膜；

T 表示T形安全膜。

金属化聚丙烯薄膜烘焙温度为120℃±2℃，烘焙时间为10min；金属化聚酯薄膜烘焙温度为150℃±2℃，烘焙时间为15min。

items.description:
Metallized BOPP Capacitor Film (sliver)

Metallized BOPP Capacitor Film (sliver film) have two items :
1. Zn/Al Metallized BOPP Capacitor Film (sliver film)
2. Al Metallized BOPP Capacitor Film (sliver film)
reinforced edge ( of Aluminum/Zinc film ) are : 1.5,2.0,2.5 MM
The standard thickness range including: 3,4,5,6,7,8,9,10,12 microns .
The standard tolerance thickness: +/-0.2 Um .
The standard width range including: 30,40,50,60,70,80,90,100,120,130 MM
The standard tolerance width: +/-5 MM.
The inner core : 3" (76MM)
The outer core: 150-350 MM .
Features:
1) single side corona treated for the Zn or Zn/Al metallized .

Tech data :

Zinc/aluminium alloy metallised PP-film with heavy edge and improved corrosion stability. Base film is produced with super clean electrical grade resin.
GENERAL APPLICATIONS ( VMPP film)
AC low voltage power capacitors with highest stresses and largest units. Suitable also for motor run and lighting capacitors.
Properties

items.summary: Metalized BOPP film heat sealable one side and treated the other side
items.description:
Metalized BOPP film heat sealable one side and treated the other side.

[Metalized BOPP film heat sealable one side and treated the other side.]


1// Product Description
Metalized BOPP film heat sealable one side and treated the other side.
2// General Use
It is used in laminations with other films for packaging of foodstuffs such as crackers, chips and other "snacks", requiring a good seal and large rate of sealing.
3// Properties and Tolerance
4// Packing
The standard armed pallet will have a polyester band, triple tensioned wrapping, floor and roof covered with PE or CPP and one wood plank will join another like an "H".
The pallet will be composed of 2 to 6 reels of equal width and thickness. The caps should be plywood preferably triple and must be of 25mm thickness.
The reels should have up to 2 connections per roll and shall not exceed 10% of the total batch.
5// Warranty.
The supplier shall certify that the film will maintain its physical and chemical properties for a minimum period of 6 months from the date of production, for each lot a certificate of quality containing the physical and/or chemical analysis will be sent.
The supplier shall ensure that the film can be used in direct contact with food and that meets the requirements in accordance with the regulations of the EEC 90/128 and the FDA# 21 CFR 177.1720
6// Identification
Each reel must have an external label with the following information:
//Supplier Name.
//Type of Film.
//Purchase Order ·
//Code of the material.
//Date of manufacture.
//Due Date.
//Meters, width and thickness
//Gross Weight and net weight.
//Internal or external Treated Layer
//Number of connections
7//Storage and Handling
It is not recommended submitting the film to conditions of high humidity and extreme temperatures, it is recommended to avoid any moisture condensation on the film, and that will not exceed an ambient temperature of 35º C and a relative humidity of 60 %, it is recommended to protect the reels from direct exposure to sunlight or heat sources.
The pallet must be transported and protected with a plastic cover until its use; the palletizing must be made with dry wood to ensure no moisture release in the transportation.
8// Foreign bodies
The film should have no strange smell and should be free from foreign bodies.
9// Microbiology
The film will not show a count greater than 100 cfu/g of aerobic mesophile and must be completely free of bacteria.
10//Toxicological information
The film does not have specific danger when it is used in an appropriate manner and is not associated with any toxic compound, there are no known carcinogenic effects of these compounds, are not used substances that can cause damage to health, it is a flammable product, but may burn when it is exposed to the flame by releasing a smoke harmful to health, preventing breathing.

SIGMAPLAST reserves the right to refuse a lot or disqualify a supplier by not complying with the tolerances exposed.

items.descriptionZh:
BOPP封箱胶带大母卷

BOPP胶粘带大母卷 (1280MMx4000M) / BOPP adhesive tape Jumbo rolls (1280/1600MMx4000M)
BOPP（双向拉伸聚丙烯）胶带即封箱用BOPP压敏胶粘带
1. 胶带介绍：
胶带是在BOPP原膜的基础上经过高压电晕后使一面表面粗糙后涂上胶水后经过分条分成小卷就是我们日常使用的胶带。胶带胶水是丙烯酸脂胶水，又叫压敏胶，主要成分是酊脂。酊脂是一种高分子活动物质，温度高低对分子活动有一定影响。胶水的酊脂含量直接影响到胶带的使用情况。正常的封箱胶带的初粘力在≥13号（钢球号）之间，这种胶带胶水的厚度一般为22微米。是符合标准的厚度。
胶带按他的功效分可以分为：高温胶带、双面胶带 、绝缘胶带 、特种胶带-压敏胶带 、模切胶带 ，不同的功效适合不同的行业需求；
胶带基本测试项目如下：
1 外观 HG/T 2408 - 1992
QB/T 2422 - 1998
2 尺寸 HG/T 2408 - 1992
QB/T 2422 - 1998
3 初粘性 GB/T 4852
4 持粘性 GB/T 4851
5 拉伸强度（纵向）、断裂伸长率 GB/T 7753
6 撕裂度（横向） GB/T 455.1
7 基材厚度 GB/T 7125
8 纸管芯内径 QB/T 2422-1998
9 180℃剥离强度 常态（湿热老化） GB/T 2792

items.descriptionZh:
BOPP水胶胶带半成品

胶带是在BOPP原膜的基础上经过高压电晕后使一面表面粗糙后覆涂胶水后经过分条分成小卷.

普通封箱胶带胶水是丙烯酸脂胶水，又叫压敏胶，主要成分是酊脂。酊脂是一种高分子活动物质.胶带的胶水好坏在使用中有两个标准，一个是初粘力，一个是保持力，两者是成反比的

医用系列胶带、包装系列胶带、商标纸系列胶带、特种胶带、耐高温系列胶带及电脑喷绘系列胶带

胶带的基本技术指标：

产品名称：BOPP包装胶带

基材：BOPP双向拉伸聚丙烯膜 胶粘剂：丙烯酸脂胶水

总厚度……………… 52um

初粘力……………… 18# 

180°剥离力（对不锈钢板）……………… 0.65kg/25mm

保持力……………… 24hrs

抗张强度……………… 30N/cm

伸长率……………… 180％

用“宽×长×厚度”表示，其中“宽”即是胶带的宽度，一般用mm或cm表示，一般≥12mm，常见规格有：50mm、45mm、40mm等；“ 长”为胶带拉开以后的总长度，一般用“m”或“码”表示（1码=0.9144m），常见长度有50m、100m、150m、200m等；厚度是指BOPP原膜+胶层的总厚度（单位：微米、μm），常用的有45～50μm。如“50cm×100m×50μm” 胶带行业通常用“元/平方米”来核算胶带价格，那么“每卷胶带价格=宽度（m）*长度（m）*平方价”具体价格

items.descriptionZh:
BOPP封箱胶带大母卷/BOPP adhesive tape Jumbo-roll (1280MMx4000M)

BOPP（双向拉伸聚丙烯）胶带即封箱用BOPP压敏胶粘带
1. 胶带介绍：
胶带是在BOPP原膜的基础上经过高压电晕后使一面表面粗糙后涂上胶水后经过分条分成小卷就是我们日常使用的胶带。胶带胶水是丙烯酸脂胶水，又叫压敏胶，主要成分是酊脂。酊脂是一种高分子活动物质，温度高低对分子活动有一定影响。胶水的酊脂含量直接影响到胶带的使用情况。正常的封箱胶带的初粘力在≥13号（钢球号）之间，这种胶带胶水的厚度一般为22微米。是符合标准的厚度。
胶带按他的功效分可以分为：高温胶带、双面胶带 、绝缘胶带 、特种胶带-压敏胶带 、模切胶带 ，不同的功效适合不同的行业需求；

1 外观 HG/T 2408 - 1992
QB/T 2422 - 1998

QB/T 2422 - 1998

美纹纸胶带

1.美纹纸胶带是以美纹纸和压敏胶水为主要原料，在美纹纸上涂覆压敏胶粘剂，另一面涂以防粘材料而制成的卷状胶粘带。具有耐高温、抗化学溶剂佳、高粘着力、柔软服贴和再撕不留残胶等特性。行业通称美纹纸压敏胶粘带。英文名MASKING TAPE。
应用领域该胶带以进口白色美纹纸为基材，单面涂布耐候性橡胶系压敏胶而成。具有耐高温，耐溶剂、再剥离无残胶等优异性能！产品符合ROHS环保要求。适用于汽车,铁制或塑料器件家具表面的耐高温烤漆喷漆遮蔽保护,同时也适用于电子\电器\压敏电阻\线路板等行业。

1.美纹纸胶带是以美纹纸和压敏胶水为主要原料，在美纹纸上涂覆压敏胶粘剂，另一面涂以防粘材料而制成的卷状胶粘带。具有耐高温、抗化学溶剂佳、高粘着力、柔软服贴和再撕不留残胶等特性。行业通称美纹纸压敏胶粘带。英文名MASKING TAPE。
应用领域该胶带以进口白色美纹纸为基材，单面涂布耐候性橡胶系压敏胶而成。具有耐高温，耐溶剂、再剥离无残胶等优异性能！产品符合ROHS环保要求。适用于汽车,铁制或塑料器件家具表面的耐高温烤漆喷漆遮蔽保护,同时也适用于电子\电器\压敏电阻\线路板等行业。

长度：4000M

items.descriptionZh:
BOPET 预涂膜

是指预先将塑料薄膜上胶、复卷后，再与纸张印品复合的工艺。它先由预涂膜加工厂根据使用规格、幅面，将胶液涂布在薄膜上复卷后供使用厂家选择，而后再与印刷品进行复合。覆膜，即贴膜，就是将塑料薄膜涂上黏合剂，与纸印刷品经加热、加压后使之黏合在一起，形成纸塑合一产品的加工技术。经覆膜的印刷品，由于表面多了一层薄而透明的塑料薄膜，表面更平滑光亮，从而提高印刷品的光泽度和牢度，图文颜色更鲜艳，富有立体感，同时更起到防水、防污、耐磨、耐摺、耐化学腐蚀等作用。
BOPET预涂膜高光（高亮）

材质： BOPET薄膜+EVA黏合剂胶层

特点：透明度高、光亮度好、无毒无味、耐水、耐热、质地柔软等。

厚度：10,12,15,17,18，20，22，24，25，27，28，30，32，35微米

其中：BOPET薄膜厚度一般为06—20微米，EVA胶层厚度一般5-10微米左右。

宽度：325-1050MM

长度：4000M

包装：标准托盘包装

用途：适用于各种纸张、油墨的表面覆膜，对喷粉的印刷品有较强的修饰能力。经过电晕处理的表面可以适应覆膜后的UV上光、烫印、网印等工艺。

items.title: PET thermal lamination film
items.description:
PET thermal lamination film

 BOPET thermal laminating film is that use extrusion thermal process to combine heat sensitive layers with BOPET film by adhesive

Advantages:

3. BOPET thermal laminating film is very popular in lamination market.
4. BOPET films have a wide range of application; therefore there are various appearances of laminating films. For instance: Matte, Glossy, Silky matte, Scuff free etc.
3. BOPET thermal laminating films are environmental friendly. There are non-hazardous to our health, no toxic gases or volatile content is emitted.
4. Super gloss, high transparency, waterproof and chemical proof.
Applications:
• Cover on the paper, for example: Books, Magazines, Catalogs, Posters, Leaflets, Diaries, Calendars and Maps etc.
• Any types of boxes, for instance: Gift boxes
• Medicine
• Advertisements
• Cosmetics

• Digital printing and showing board
